1	// app/Sources/EditorViewController+Graphics.swift — the preview's answer to
2	// a module, font or asset changing on disk (road map 10 G3b; G-13, preview
3	// follows the newest revision). The plan does not change when a module
4	// does, so the §7.6 rebuild rule would skip it; the registry has already
5	// swapped the compiled set in, and a paused frame is recomposed by the
6	// one-tick round trip. A playing preview picks the new set up on its next
7	// frame by itself.
8	
9	import AppKit
10	
11	extension EditorViewController {
12	    @objc func graphicsDidChange(_ note: Notification) {
13	        guard let document = document, note.object as? ProjectDocument === document else { return }
14	        playback.refreshPausedFrame()
15	        inspector?.refresh(isLive: false)
16	    }
17	}
18

1	// app/Sources/GraphicRegistry.swift — the compiled graphics each document
2	// draws with (road map 10 §5f's registry paragraph, G3b): a `RecipeSource`
3	// key → one immutable `GraphicSet`, the library and every module of that
4	// document's `graphics/` compiled against it.
5	//
6	// **Preview follows the newest revision** (G-13): the document installs its
7	// set when its store starts and swaps a NEW set in on every
8	// `.graphicsDidChange` (`ProjectDocument+Graphics.swift`). A font or asset
9	// change builds a new library and recompiles every module against it — a
10	// library is frozen by its first compile — and anything else recompiles only
11	// the named modules against the existing library. Nothing here calls
12	// `store.rescan()`: `drain()` is not re-entrant (road map 10 §10.6 G3a).
13	//
14	// **Threading.** `install`, `update`, `remove` and `entry` are main-only,
15	// because the store's scan is. `resolve`, `snapshot` and the pin's five
16	// calls are any-thread — the compositor's render queue and a `render_frame`
17	// generator thread — and the lock covers only the two maps; a module draws
18	// on a thread that did not compile it (the engine keeps per-thread
19	// runtimes, G1c).
20	//
21	// **An offline key** — the one `Exporter.renderFrame` or an export mints —
22	// draws with the set its caller PINNED on it (G-13, G3c): the document's
23	// set as it stood when the export or the frame was asked for, retained for
24	// the key's life however the document's own set changes. A key with no
25	// set and no pin resolves nil and the layer draws the slate. A pin also
26	// holds what the key's graphics REPORTED — the first failure in a slot of
27	// its own, then up to 64 warnings distinct by graphic and messages, the
28	// frame aside, so one graphic warning every frame keeps one (G-24 (c)) — for
29	// `render_frame`'s reply, the export's abort and its `graphicWarnings`.
30	
31	import Foundation
32	
33	/// One document's compiled graphics at one instant. Immutable: a change
34	/// makes a new one, so a frame in flight keeps a coherent set.
35	final class GraphicSet {
36	    let library: GraphicLibrary
37	    /// The store's `GraphicScan.libraryVersion` the library was built from —
38	    /// part of the texture key, so a font change never serves an old raster.
39	    let libraryVersion: String
40	    let modules: [String: GraphicRegistry.Entry]
41	    /// The library could not be built, so `library` is an empty stand-in:
42	    /// no module may be compiled against it, and `update` rebuilds instead.
43	    let libraryFailed: Bool
44	
45	    init(
46	        library: GraphicLibrary, libraryVersion: String, modules: [String: GraphicRegistry.Entry],
47	        libraryFailed: Bool = false
48	    ) {
49	        self.library = library
50	        self.libraryVersion = libraryVersion
51	        self.modules = modules
52	        self.libraryFailed = libraryFailed
53	    }
54	}
55	
56	/// What one graphic reported while an offline key drew it: a failure (the
57	/// error card was drawn) or a warning, with the graphic's own frame — nil
58	/// when the module did not compile.
59	struct GraphicReport: Equatable {
60	    let name: String
61	    let frame: Int?
62	    let failed: Bool
63	    let diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic]
64	}
65	
66	final class GraphicRegistry {
67	    static let shared = GraphicRegistry()
68	
69	    /// The engine's budgets, in milliseconds: a compile, one preview frame,
70	    /// and one frame of an export or a `render_frame`.
71	    static let compileBudgetMs = 250, previewBudgetMs = 250, offlineBudgetMs = 2000
72	
73	    /// One module as compiled against a set's library: the module with its
74	    /// file's revision and its `describe` parsed, or why it did not compile.
75	    enum Entry {
76	        case compiled(GraphicModule, revision: String, meta: [String: Any], schema: [String: Any])
77	        case failed([GraphicDiagnostic], revision: String)
78	    }
79	
80	    /// An offline key's pinned set and what its graphics reported. The
81	    /// FIRST failure owns `failure` for the pin's life, so a graphic that
82	    /// warns on every frame can fill `warnings` and never hide it.
83	    private struct Pin {
84	        let set: GraphicSet
85	        var failure: GraphicReport?
86	        var warnings: [GraphicReport]
87	    }
88	
89	    /// Warnings a pin keeps; a later distinct one is dropped.
90	    static let warningLimit = 64
91	
92	    private let lock = NSLock()
93	    private var sets: [Int: GraphicSet] = [:]
94	    private var pins: [Int: Pin] = [:]
95	
96	    private init() {}
97	
98	    /// Compiles every module the store's scan holds against a NEW library
99	    /// and publishes the set under `key`. Main.
100	    func install(_ store: GraphicStore, for key: Int) {
101	        let scan = store.scan
102	        let set: GraphicSet
103	        do {
104	            let library = try store.makeLibrary()
105	            set = GraphicSet(
106	                library: library, libraryVersion: scan.libraryVersion,
107	                modules: scan.modules.mapValues { Self.compile($0, library: library) })
108	        } catch {
109	            // The library could not be built (a font the engine refused):
110	            // every module fails with that sentence and draws the slate.
111	            let reason = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
112	            set = GraphicSet(
113	                library: GraphicLibrary(), libraryVersion: scan.libraryVersion,
114	                modules: scan.modules.mapValues { .failed(reason, revision: $0.revision) },
115	                libraryFailed: true)
116	        }
117	        publish(set, for: key)
118	    }
119	
120	    /// Answers one `.graphicsDidChange`. `library` true is a font or asset
121	    /// change: a new library and every module recompiled. Otherwise only
122	    /// `names` are recompiled, against the EXISTING library — a frozen
123	    /// library refuses adds, not compiles — and a name the scan no longer
124	    /// holds is dropped. A set whose library failed is rebuilt whole, so no
125	    /// module compiles against its empty stand-in. Always a new set. Main.
126	    func update(_ store: GraphicStore, for key: Int, names: [String], library: Bool) {
127	        lock.lock()
128	        let current = sets[key]
129	        lock.unlock()
130	        guard let current = current, !library, !current.libraryFailed else {
131	            install(store, for: key)
132	            return
133	        }
134	        let scan = store.scan
135	        var modules = current.modules
136	        for name in names {
137	            if let file = scan.modules[name] {
138	                modules[name] = Self.compile(file, library: current.library)
139	            } else {
140	                modules.removeValue(forKey: name)
141	            }
142	        }
143	        publish(
144	            GraphicSet(
145	                library: current.library, libraryVersion: current.libraryVersion,
146	                modules: modules),
147	            for: key)
148	    }
149	
150	    /// Drops a document's set, when its store stops. Main.
151	    func remove(_ key: Int) {
152	        lock.lock()
153	        defer { lock.unlock() }
154	        sets.removeValue(forKey: key)
155	    }
156	
157	    /// The module `name` as the document keyed `key` has it compiled — the
158	    /// op tools' read of `meta` and `schema`. Main.
159	    func entry(named name: String, for key: Int) -> Entry? {
160	        lock.lock()
161	        defer { lock.unlock() }
162	        return sets[key]?.modules[name]
163	    }
164	
165	    /// The set a document keyed `key` draws with right now — what an export
166	    /// or a `render_frame` pins. Any thread.
167	    func snapshot(for key: Int) -> GraphicSet? {
168	        lock.lock()
169	        defer { lock.unlock() }
170	        return sets[key]
171	    }
172	
173	    /// Opens `key`'s pin on `set`: an offline key draws with it until
174	    /// `unpin`, and records its reports. Any thread.
175	    func pin(_ set: GraphicSet, for key: Int) {
176	        lock.lock()
177	        defer { lock.unlock() }
178	        pins[key] = Pin(set: set, failure: nil, warnings: [])
179	    }
180	
181	    /// Drops `key`'s pin and its reports; a no-op for a key never pinned.
182	    /// Any thread.
183	    func unpin(_ key: Int) {
184	        lock.lock()
185	        defer { lock.unlock() }
186	        pins.removeValue(forKey: key)
187	    }
188	
189	    /// Keeps `report` against a pinned key; a no-op for any other key. A
190	    /// failure fills the failure slot if it is empty and is dropped
191	    /// otherwise; a warning is appended unless the same one (`sameWarning`)
192	    /// is held or `warningLimit` are. Any thread.
193	    func record(_ report: GraphicReport, for key: Int) {
194	        lock.lock()
195	        defer { lock.unlock() }
196	        guard var pin = pins[key] else { return }
197	        if report.failed {
198	            guard pin.failure == nil else { return }
199	            pin.failure = report
200	        } else {
201	            guard pin.warnings.count < Self.warningLimit,
202	                !pin.warnings.contains(where: { Self.sameWarning($0, report) })
203	            else { return }
204	            pin.warnings.append(report)
205	        }
206	        pins[key] = pin
207	    }
208	
209	    /// Everything `key`'s pin holds: the failure first, then the warnings in
210	    /// the order they arrived. Any thread.
211	    func reports(for key: Int) -> [GraphicReport] {
212	        lock.lock()
213	        defer { lock.unlock() }
214	        guard let pin = pins[key] else { return [] }
215	        return (pin.failure.map { [$0] } ?? []) + pin.warnings
216	    }
217	
218	    /// One graphic's same warning at another frame: the name and every
219	    /// diagnostic's located message equal, the frame aside (G-24 (c)).
220	    static func sameWarning(_ a: GraphicReport, _ b: GraphicReport) -> Bool {
221	        a.name == b.name && a.diagnostics.map(\.located) == b.diagnostics.map(\.located)
222	    }
223	
224	    /// The pin's failure slot — the first failure it recorded. Any thread.
225	    func failure(for key: Int) -> GraphicReport? {
226	        lock.lock()
227	        defer { lock.unlock() }
228	        return pins[key]?.failure
229	    }
230	
231	    /// The set a recipe under `key` draws with, and the per-frame budget:
232	    /// a document's own key answers its set at the preview budget; a
233	    /// pinned offline key answers its pinned set at the offline budget;
234	    /// anything else is nil. Any thread.
235	    func resolve(_ key: Int) -> (set: GraphicSet, budgetMs: Int)? {
236	        lock.lock()
237	        defer { lock.unlock() }
238	        if let own = sets[key] { return (own, Self.previewBudgetMs) }
239	        if let pinned = pins[key] { return (pinned.set, Self.offlineBudgetMs) }
240	        return nil
241	    }
242	
243	    private func publish(_ set: GraphicSet, for key: Int) {
244	        lock.lock()
245	        defer { lock.unlock() }
246	        sets[key] = set
247	    }
248	
249	    /// One module file compiled against `library`, its `describe` parsed.
250	    static func compile(_ file: GraphicModuleFile, library: GraphicLibrary) -> Entry {
251	        let source = String(decoding: file.bytes, as: UTF8.self)
252	        do {
253	            let module = try GraphicModule.compile(
254	                library: library, name: file.name, source: source, budgetMs: compileBudgetMs)
255	            let described = (try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(
256	                with: Data(module.describeJSON().utf8))) as? [String: Any]
257	            return .compiled(
258	                module, revision: file.revision,
259	                meta: described?["meta"] as? [String: Any] ?? [:],
260	                schema: described?["schema"] as? [String: Any] ?? [:])
261	        } catch {
262	            return .failed(GraphicDiagnostic.of(error), revision: file.revision)
263	        }
264	    }
265	}
266	
267	extension GraphicModule {
268	    /// `describeJSON()`'s `warnings` — what the module's top level warned as
269	    /// it loaded (G-21 (b), G-24 (a)) — decoded; `[]` when absent or
270	    /// unreadable. Main or any thread.
271	    var compileWarnings: [GraphicDiagnostic] {
272	        struct Described: Decodable { let warnings: [GraphicDiagnostic]? }
273	        let described = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Described.self, from: Data(describeJSON().utf8))
274	        return described?.warnings ?? []
275	    }
276	}

# app/CLAUDE.md — Swift app rules

Applies to everything under `app/`. Build/verification commands and the FFI
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§3–4 the UI, §7.4–7.8 the platform side; its `README.md` is
the index). The
long form of each entry below — why each file is the shape it is, and the
traps its history turned up — is `designs/adr/app-file-history.md` (the
full history, every size toll and measurement, is archived; see its
"Original" line); this file is what governs a file now. Files
are listed by family; a file with a header comment of its own carries its
detail there.

## File map

**The core's edge.**
- `ReelCore.swift` — with its `ReelCore+<Area>.swift` files, the only files
  that call `rc_*` (spec §11 CJ-8 (l)); a new wrapper goes in the file of its
  area. `ReelCore.swift` holds `ReelProject`
  (handle + lazily decoded `ProjectSnapshot`; `json`, `snapshot` and
  `planJSON` are memoised PER HANDLE, so keep handles rather than minting
  them; so is `sourceMap(_:)`, `rc_project_source_map` decoded and checked
  once per handle and clip, SR-20), timecode, snapping (export presets/sizes/settings are
  `ExportValues.swift`'s, a pure move, HDR H-1), `ReelSpeed.limits` (the
  core's speed range and audio ceiling, typed as `SpeedLimits` in
  `CoreValues.swift` — no Swift file types a speed bound), `ReelColor` (`rc_normalise_color`, G-25) and `ReelAgentSocket` (below);
  `ReelCore+MediaFiles.swift` holds the media files the core reads or writes —
  `ReelContainer` (`rc_container_*`, a WebM/Matroska file's index, #216-R), `ReelCube`,
  `ReelHDR10` (`rc_hdr10_peak`, spec §11 HD-6; `av1Peak`, `rc_hdr10_av1_peak`, HD-18;
  `stillPeak`, `rc_hdr10_still_peak`, HD-20), `ReelAV1` and `ReelWebM` (`rc_webm_*`, the
  `av1_webm` writer, spec §11 CX-15) — `ReelCore+Cursor.swift` holds `ReelCursor`
  (`rc_cursor_open`, `rc_cursor_free`: a cursor file's open, which is its check, spec
  §11 CU-9, CU-15; road map creator-jobs CU1a; and `query`, `rc_cursor_query`'s one
  JSON request, CU2, spec §11 CU-25, and the static `query(_:tracks:project:)`, the
  same call over n tracks with a project (`plan_zooms`, CU-70)) — `ReelCore+Framing.swift`
  holds `SpeakerMatch` and `ReelProject.speakerMatch` (`rc_project_speaker_match`, road map
  creator-jobs VR6b, spec §11 VR-65: the face-to-microphone match Make Vertical's sheet
  confirms) — and `ReelCore+Graphics.swift` the graphics engine's
  wrappers (below), with `ReelGraphicPackage` (`rc_graphic_package_write`, G-46; `read`,
  `rc_graphic_package_read`, G-47), `GraphicLibrary.usage()` (`rc_graphic_library_usage`)
  and `GraphicLibrary.imageCache(limit:)` (`rc_graphic_image_cache`, G-39) — both pure moves
  out of `ReelCore.swift` (road map creator-jobs CJ0d, T15); `ReelCoreError`, `Fps.ffiPair` and `ReelTime`'s
  seconds conversions are `CoreValues.swift`'s (G6 phase 5's toll T2 and speed ramps SR4-0,
  pure moves); the typed patches are `TypedPatches.swift`'s (`VideoPatch`,
  `AudioPatch`, `ClipPatch`, the `ActionPatch` extension; a pure move, B73),
  `TextPatch` (with `case`, `words` and `word_style`) is `TextPatch.swift`'s,
  moved out so it could grow, and `ShapePatch` `ShapePatch.swift`'s (a pure
  move, the toll for `ReelColor`). `VideoPatch.color` is a sparse `ColorPatch`
  (`GradeProps.swift`, which holds `ColorAdjust` (moved out of
  `ProjectSnapshot.swift`, grading-2 G2-0) with its neutrality helpers, and
  `LayerUniforms.apply(tone:)`, and the wheels' `ColorWheel`, `ColorWheels`,
  `ColorWheelPatch`, `ColorWheelsPatch`, `ColorWheelKind` and
  `LayerUniforms.apply(wheels:)` (GR-11)); `VideoPatch.curves` is
  `CurveProps.swift`'s `ColorCurvesPatch`, beside `CurvePoint`,
  `CurveDomain`, `CurveChannel`, `CurveBlend` (a channel blended inside an
  action, spec §11 GR-34; `ColorCurves.blends`, never encoded), `ColorCurves` and
  `LayerUniforms.apply(curves:)` (GR-12, the hue curves GR-32; a
  pure move out of `GradeProps.swift`, grading-4 T4-0); `VideoPatch.qualifier` is
  `QualifierProps.swift`'s `ColorQualifierPatch`, beside `ColorQualifier` (its
  `blur`, `blursSelection` and `selectionSigma`, GR-35), `QualifierUniforms`
  (`blurred`, set only by `drawAdjustment`) and the pick's `QualifierSample`
  (GR-13), so a row writes
  only its own key to every selected clip. `word_style` has ONE
  app-side writer, `CaptionLayout.place` (W-10). `ReelAgentSocket` (road map
  14's MC2) wraps `rc_agent_socket_start` / `_release`: `start` throws the
  core's sentence, `release` is the quit's unlink-if-still-ours with no join;
  `answer(_:)` hands the tool callback's answer back through
  `rc_agent_string_create` (CJ0d's T15c), a plain static because the trampoline
  runs on the core's server thread, so `AgentServer.swift` names no `rc_*`.
  The `dictionary` extensions on the property types are
  `OpDictionaries.swift`'s (below).
  The graphics engine's wrappers are `ReelCore+Graphics.swift`'s: `GraphicLibrary` (`addFont`,
  `addAsset`, `rasterize`, `families()`; frozen by its first compile,
  rasterize or `families()`) and
  `GraphicModule` (`compile`, `describeJSON`, `svg`; it holds its library
  strongly); their values `GraphicDiagnostic` (with `.error`, `.noModule`
  and `.of(_:)`, the one spelling of a diagnostic made from a message, a
  missing module or a thrown error), `GraphicFailure` (what a
  `diag_out` failure throws; `err_out` stays `ReelCoreError`) and
  `GraphicRaster` are `CoreValues.swift`'s, with `GraphicUsage`, the byte
  bridges `withByteBuffer` and `withMutableByteBuffer` (G-46's toll; never
  `UnsafeMutablePointer(mutating:)`), `SpeedLimits` (a pure move,
  clean-up batch 2), `ReelCoreError` and `Fps.ffiPair` (G6 phase 5's toll), and
  `CoreJSON` (`value`, `snapTicks`: `clipState`'s and `snapCandidates`' JSON
  halves, clean-up round 3's toll; `array`, `overrides`, C1's tolls; `ExportSize.list`,
  `ExportSettings.decoded`, `ReelAV1.Config.decoded`, `withNonNullBytes`, codec-export C5's
  toll), and C1's
  fix-pass moves: `ReelAV1.Config` / `.Color` (an extension of
  `ReelCore+MediaFiles.swift`'s `ReelAV1`, whose `rc_av1_*` calls stay there), `GraphicDiagnostic.list(json:)`,
  `GraphicFailure.checkSides`, `SpeedLimits.decoded` and the free `withBytes`.
  `MediaDescriptor`, `MediaOriginal`, `mediaURL(for:)`, `originalURL(for:)`,
  `revealURL(for:)` (the original, else the copy), `cursorURL(for:)` (the
  cursor file: its bookmark when it resolves, else the stored path, existing or
  not), `isTrashed` and
  `bookmarkString(for:)` are `MediaDescriptor.swift`'s: a `media[]` element
  minus its id, and the media-file resolvers; they call no `rc_*`.
  It is also where the op table is read BACK: `ReelOp.coreNames()` over
  `rc_op_names`, and `ReelOp.coreSchemas()` over `rc_op_schemas` — every
  op's ARGUMENTS as JSON Schema, keyed by op name, which
  `AgentCatalog.opTool` prints for all sixty-nine op tools.
  `deinit` frees the Rust allocation. It also holds **the one read of
  `rc_project_apply`'s TWO message channels**, in the header's own order — a
  sentence is a refusal, an error message is invalid input, neither written
  is an identity — answered as the `ReelEdit` below.
- `OpDictionaries.swift` — the `dictionary` extensions on the §5.2
  property types (`CropInsets` … `Gradient`), the model's own key names; a
  pure move out of `ReelCore.swift` (#190, issue batch B52b; road map 14's
  MC2 made the same move as `PropsDictionaries.swift`, and the merge kept
  main's file). With
  `ReelCore.swift` and `ReelOps.swift`, the only files that write an op
  argument. `putNullable` is the one writer of a three-state (`T??`)
  patch key: absent, an explicit null, or the value.
- `ReelOps.swift` — `OpArgs`, `ReelOp` and one typed factory per row of
  `core/src/edit.rs`'s op table, plus a RAW factory beside the typed one at
  each door that takes a CALLER's own object — ELEVEN of them (`setVideoRaw`,
  `setAudioRaw`, `setTextRaw`, `setShapeRaw`, `setClipRaw`,
  `setActionEndRaw`, `addTextClipRaw`, `addShapeClipRaw`, `setCanvasRaw`,
  `addBackgroundRaw`, `addZoomActionRaw`), which takes the
  caller's own object as `Any` — never `[String: Any]`, so a non-object is
  refused by the CORE in the words that name the group — and forwards it;
  there is no untyped op-JSON call site anywhere else. Where only ONE
  argument is the caller's (a colour, a region, a new clip's patch) the typed
  factory DELEGATES to the raw one, mapping its optional explicitly, because
  an `Optional<T>.none` widened to `Any?` is a non-nil `Any` wrapping a nil.
  The typed `setActionEnd` LIFTS every top-level null out of its patch into
  `off` (spec §11 CI-14: a typed `.some(nil)` is a switch turned OFF, kept
  at the end), and a null slot inside `audio.eq` into `audio.eq.<slot>`
  (AU-88); `setActionEndRaw`'s nulls stay removals, which is what
  `clearOps` and every agent call send, and it writes `off` only when non-empty and `schema` only when non-nil
  (the agent door fills it for a graphic end from the module's current
  revision, spec §11 G-34).
  `addZoomActionRaw`'s region is `Any` and not `Any?`: an absent key and an
  explicit null are opposite intentions there, and only the tool can tell
  them apart.
  `scope` is a member folded into `json`; `documentLevelNames` MIRRORS
  `scope.rs`'s `refused_inside` (eleven names: its twelve arms but
  `add_adjustment_clip`, sent scoped) so one edit can mix a
  document-level op with scoped ones. A table, with
  `edit.rs`'s size exemption.
- `ReelOpSchema.swift` — what an op TAKES, mirroring what
  `core/src/op_schema.rs` publishes: the `properties` and `required` of one
  op's arguments, which are the two things `AgentServer.tool` takes, and
  `table(from:)`, which reads `rc_op_schemas`' JSON into them (SR4-0's pure
  move out of `ReelCore.swift`, whose `coreSchemas()` keeps the call). Here
  rather than next door for `ReelEdit.swift`'s reason — it names no `rc_*`
  symbol — and `properties` stays `[String: Any]` because a Swift type per
  kind would be another spelling of the table.
- `ReelEdit.swift` — what an op ANSWERS, mirroring `core/src/outcome.rs`:
  `ReelEdit` (`.applied` / `.identity` / `.refused`), `ReelRefusal` (the op
  the core declined and the rule's own sentence, carried verbatim), and the
  fold that applies a LIST — which names no `rc_*` symbol, so it lives here
  and not next door. **Only `.applied` is an undo step**; the other two are
  both "the project did not change" and differ only in what a caller can
  SAY. `.project` is the spelling for a caller that treats a refusal as
  nothing happened (a probe, a live drag), and there is one on
  `ReelEdit?` too for the `try?` probes. In the fold **a refusal does not

**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

1	// app/Sources/GraphicFileSheetController.swift — File ▸ Rename Graphic…,
2	// Delete Graphic… and Restore Graphic Version… (spec §11 G-30; issue #103,
3	// issue batch B84): ONE small sheet for the three, a pop-up of the
4	// project's graphics over the three bodies in
5	// `ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift` — the bodies `rename_graphic`,
6	// `delete_graphic` and `restore_graphic` call, so both doors refuse in the
7	// same sentences.
8	//
9	// **No second implementation.** Every act is one call of a body
10	// (`perform`); nothing here reaches a `GraphicStore` writer, an op or an
11	// undo registration, and no sentence a body throws is rewritten, prefixed
12	// or predicted: a refusal is shown word for word in `messageLabel` and the
13	// sheet stays up. The two guards written here name the CALL (spec §11
14	// D2-1): a new name that is empty or unchanged (`canConfirm`), and an item
15	// with nothing to list (`isOffered`).
16	//
17	// **`perform` runs from the button's action only**: each body ends in
18	// `rescan()`, which must never run from a `.graphicsDidChange` observer.
19	// Rename's `apply` is `performGroupedEdit`, never `applyEdit`: the clips'
20	// new name is one CLOSED undo step wherever the action was sent from, it
21	// does not throw, and the body's own re-read moves the file back when the
22	// edit was refused.

24	import AppKit
25	
26	/// One of the three file acts a person can ask for.
27	enum GraphicFileAct: CaseIterable {
28	    case rename, delete, restore
29	
30	    /// The File menu's title.
31	    var menuTitle: String {
32	        switch self {
33	        case .rename: return "Rename Graphic…"
34	        case .delete: return "Delete Graphic…"
35	        case .restore: return "Restore Graphic Version…"
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    /// The sheet's title: the menu's without its "…".
40	    var sheetTitle: String { String(menuTitle.dropLast()) }
41	
42	    var confirmTitle: String {
43	        switch self {
44	        case .rename: return "Rename"
45	        case .delete: return "Delete"
46	        case .restore: return "Restore"
47	        }
48	    }
49	
50	    /// The sentence under the title (spec §11 G-30 (c), word for word).
51	    var hint: String {
52	        switch self {
53	        case .rename:
54	            return "Every clip that uses the graphic follows its new name, on the timeline and "
55	                + "inside nests. Undo renames it back when a clip uses it; a graphic no clip "
56	                + "uses is renamed back by renaming it again."
57	        case .delete:
58	            return "A graphic that clips still use cannot be deleted. Its code is kept with its "
59	                + "earlier versions, so Restore Graphic Version… brings it back. Deleting is "
60	                + "not an Undo step."
61	        case .restore:
62	            return "Puts back the newest kept version of the graphic's code. If the graphic has "
63	                + "code now, that code is kept in its place, so restoring again returns to "
64	                + "where you were. Restoring is not an Undo step."
65	        }
66	    }
67	}
68	
69	/// One row of the sheet's pop-up.
70	struct GraphicFileChoice: Equatable {
71	    let name: String
72	    /// No `graphics/<name>.js`: a deleted module that still has kept texts.
73	    let deleted: Bool
74	    /// How many texts of it are kept.
75	    let kept: Int
76	
77	    var title: String { deleted ? "\(name) (deleted)" : name }
78	}
79	
80	final class GraphicFileSheetController: NSViewController, NSTextFieldDelegate {
81	    /// Weak, like every sheet's back-reference.
82	    private weak var document: ProjectDocument?
83	    private let act: GraphicFileAct
84	    private let choices: [GraphicFileChoice]
85	    private let opening: String?
86	
87	    private let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
88	    private let nameField = NSTextField(string: "")
89	    private let keptLabel = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
90	    private let messageLabel = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
91	    private let confirmButton: NSButton
92	
93	    private static let controlWidth: CGFloat = 240
94	
95	    // MARK: - The model
96	
97	    /// The rows an act lists, by name: the folder's modules for Rename and
98	    /// Delete; every name with a kept text for Restore, deleted modules
99	    /// included. Empty with no store.
100	    static func choices(for act: GraphicFileAct, in document: ProjectDocument)
101	        -> [GraphicFileChoice]
102	    {
103	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else { return [] }
104	        let names: [String]
105	        switch act {
106	        case .rename, .delete:
107	            return store.scan.modules.keys.sorted().map {
108	                GraphicFileChoice(name: $0, deleted: false, kept: store.kept(named: $0).count)
109	            }
110	        case .restore:
111	            names = store.keptNames()
112	        }
113	        return names.map {
114	            GraphicFileChoice(
115	                name: $0, deleted: !store.holdsModule(named: $0),
116	                kept: store.kept(named: $0).count)
117	        }
118	    }
119	
120	    /// Whether the menu item is live: something to list, and for Rename no
121	    /// nest open (spec §11 G-28 (g)). A validator asks this on every menu
122	    /// open, so it answers whether `choices` would be empty without
123	    /// building them: Rename and Delete from the last scan, Restore from
124	    /// `keptNames()`, and no row's `kept` count is read.
125	    static func isOffered(_ act: GraphicFileAct, in document: ProjectDocument) -> Bool {
126	        if act == .rename, document.scope != nil { return false }
127	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else { return false }
128	        switch act {
129	        case .rename, .delete: return !store.scan.modules.isEmpty
130	        case .restore: return !store.keptNames().isEmpty
131	        }
132	    }
133	
134	    /// The row the sheet opens on: for Rename and Restore the selected
135	    /// clip's graphic when it is a row, else — and always for Delete, whose
136	    /// selected clip's graphic is in use — the first; nil with no rows.
137	    static func opening(
138	        for act: GraphicFileAct, selected: String?, in choices: [GraphicFileChoice]
139	    ) -> String? {
140	        var asked = selected
141	        if act == .delete { asked = nil }
142	        if let asked = asked, choices.contains(where: { $0.name == asked }) { return asked }
143	        return choices.first?.name
144	    }
145	
146	    static func keptLine(_ kept: Int) -> String {
147	        kept == 1 ? "1 version kept" : "\(kept) versions kept"
148	    }
149	
150	    /// Whether the button is live: Rename needs a new name that is not the
151	    /// chosen one.
152	    static func canConfirm(_ act: GraphicFileAct, name: String, to: String) -> Bool {
153	        act != .rename || (!to.isEmpty && to != name)
154	    }
155	
156	    /// The act itself: one call of the body its tool calls. `to` is
157	    /// Rename's alone and goes to the body as typed.
158	    static func perform(
159	        _ act: GraphicFileAct, name: String, to: String, on document: ProjectDocument
160	    ) throws {
161	        switch act {
162	        case .rename:
163	            _ = try document.renameGraphic(named: name, to: to) {
164	                document.performGroupedEdit("Rename Graphic", $0)
165	            }
166	        case .delete:
167	            _ = try document.deleteGraphic(named: name)
168	        case .restore:
169	            _ = try document.restoreGraphic(named: name, revision: nil)
170	        }
171	    }
172	
173	    // MARK: - Life cycle
174	
175	    init(
176	        document: ProjectDocument, act: GraphicFileAct, choices: [GraphicFileChoice],
177	        opening: String?
178	    ) {
179	        self.document = document
180	        self.act = act
181	        self.choices = choices
182	        self.opening = opening
183	        self.confirmButton = StickerButton(
184	            title: act.confirmTitle, style: .primary, target: nil, action: nil)
185	        super.init(nibName: nil, bundle: nil)
186	    }
187	
188	    @available(*, unavailable)
189	    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
190	        fatalError("GraphicFileSheetController does not support NSCoder")
191	    }
192	
193	    override func loadView() {
194	        // Rows are `NSMenuItem`s carrying the name: `addItem(withTitle:)`
195	        // removes a row with the same title, and a row is never read by index.
196	        for choice in choices {
197	            let row = NSMenuItem(title: choice.title, action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
198	            row.representedObject = choice.name
199	            popup.menu?.addItem(row)
200	        }
201	        if let row = popup.itemArray.first(where: { $0.representedObject as? String == opening }) {
202	            popup.select(row)
203	        }
204	        popup.font = DS.sans(13)
205	        popup.target = self
206	        popup.action = #selector(popupChanged(_:))
207	        popup.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: Self.controlWidth).isActive = true
208	        popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.popup")
209	
210	        nameField.delegate = self
211	        nameField.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: Self.controlWidth).isActive = true
212	        DSField.style(nameField)
213	        nameField.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.name")
214	
215	        keptLabel.font = DS.mono(11)
216	        keptLabel.textColor = DS.textMuted
217	        keptLabel.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.kept")
218	
219	        messageLabel.font = DS.sans(12)
220	        messageLabel.textColor = DS.textStrong
221	        messageLabel.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = sheetWidth - sheetInset * 2
222	        messageLabel.isHidden = true
223	        messageLabel.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.message")
224	
225	        var rows: [[NSView]] = [[fieldLabel("Graphic:"), popup]]
226	        if act == .rename { rows.append([fieldLabel("New name:"), nameField]) }
227	        if act == .restore { rows.append([NSGridCell.emptyContentView, keptLabel]) }
228	        let grid = makeSheetGrid(rows)
229	
230	        let content = sheetColumn([grid, messageLabel])
231	
232	        confirmButton.target = self
233	        confirmButton.action = #selector(confirmClicked(_:))
234	        confirmButton.setAccessibilityIdentifier("graphicfile.confirm")
235	        let cancelButton = sheetCancelButton(target: self, action: #selector(cancelClicked(_:)))
236	        view = makeSheetView(
237	            title: act.sheetTitle, hint: act.hint, content: content,
238	            buttonRow: makeButtonRow(
239	                cancel: cancelButton, apply: confirmButton,
240	                leading: act == .rename ? [sheetFootnote("lowercase letters, digits and -")] : []))
241	        syncChoice()
242	    }
243	
244	    // MARK: - Values
245	
246	    private var chosenName: String? { popup.selectedItem?.representedObject as? String }
247	
248	    /// The chosen row into the controls that follow it: Rename's field and
249	    /// Restore's kept line; then the button.
250	    private func syncChoice() {
251	        let name = chosenName
252	        nameField.stringValue = name ?? ""
253	        let kept = choices.first { $0.name == name }?.kept ?? 0
254	        keptLabel.stringValue = Self.keptLine(kept)
255	        syncConfirm()
256	    }
257	
258	    private func syncConfirm() {
259	        confirmButton.isEnabled = chosenName.map {
260	            Self.canConfirm(act, name: $0, to: nameField.stringValue)
261	        } ?? false
262	    }
263	
264	    // MARK: - Controls
265	
266	    @objc private func popupChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
267	        syncChoice()
268	    }
269	
270	    func controlTextDidChange(_ obj: Notification) {
271	        syncConfirm()
272	    }
273	
274	    // MARK: - Commit
275	
276	    @objc private func cancelClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
277	        dismiss(self)
278	    }
279	
280	    /// The act, once. A refusal beeps and shows the body's sentence, and
281	    /// the sheet stays up; a success closes it and says nothing.
282	    @objc private func confirmClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
283	        guard let document = document, let name = chosenName,
284	            Self.canConfirm(act, name: name, to: nameField.stringValue)
285	        else {
286	            NSSound.beep()
287	            return
288	        }
289	        do {
290	            try Self.perform(act, name: name, to: nameField.stringValue, on: document)
291	        } catch {
292	            NSSound.beep()
293	            let message = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
294	            messageLabel.stringValue = message
295	            messageLabel.isHidden = false
296	            return
297	        }
298	        dismiss(self)
299	    }
300	}

3	/// File ▸ Rename Graphic…, Delete Graphic… and Restore Graphic Version…
4	/// (spec §11 G-30; issue #103, issue batch B84): three menu actions, the
5	/// one place their sheet goes up, and their validator arm. The sheet,
6	/// `GraphicFileSheetController`, calls the bodies the three tools call
7	/// (`ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift`); nothing here writes a file or
8	/// applies an op.
9	///
10	/// **Where a sheet opens** (G-30 (d)): Rename and Restore on the graphic of
11	/// the ONE selected clip when it is a row, else the first; Delete always on
12	/// the first. `selectedClips` is the open scope's selection.
13	///
14	/// **When an item is live** (G-30 (f)): something to list, and for Rename
15	/// no nest open. `validateGraphicMenuAction`'s default arm forwards here;
16	/// the frozen file's validator has already answered false with a sheet
17	/// attached. On every menu open Rename and Delete ask the last scan, and
18	/// Restore `keptNames()`: file names under `graphics/history/`, no bytes.
19	extension EditorViewController {
20	
21	    /// File ▸ Rename Graphic… — `rename_graphic`'s body.
22	    @objc func renameGraphic(_ sender: Any?) {
23	        presentGraphicFileSheet(.rename)
24	    }
25	
26	    /// File ▸ Delete Graphic… — `delete_graphic`'s body.
27	    @objc func deleteGraphic(_ sender: Any?) {
28	        presentGraphicFileSheet(.delete)
29	    }
30	
31	    /// File ▸ Restore Graphic Version… — `restore_graphic`'s body, the
32	    /// newest kept text.
33	    @objc func restoreGraphicVersion(_ sender: Any?) {
34	        presentGraphicFileSheet(.restore)
35	    }
36	
37	    /// The sheet for `act`, or a beep when the item has nothing to offer.
38	    func presentGraphicFileSheet(_ act: GraphicFileAct) {
39	        guard let document = document, GraphicFileSheetController.isOffered(act, in: document)
40	        else {
41	            NSSound.beep()
42	            return
43	        }
44	        let choices = GraphicFileSheetController.choices(for: act, in: document)
45	        let clips = selectedClips
46	        let selected = clips.count == 1 ? clips[0].graphic?.name : nil
47	        let sheet = GraphicFileSheetController(
48	            document: document, act: act, choices: choices,
49	            opening: GraphicFileSheetController.opening(for: act, selected: selected, in: choices))
50	        presentAsSheet(sheet)
51	    }
52	
53	    /// The menu arm for the three; nil for any other action.
54	    func validateGraphicFileAction(_ action: Selector) -> Bool? {
55	        let act: GraphicFileAct
56	        switch action {
57	        case #selector(renameGraphic(_:)): act = .rename
58	        case #selector(deleteGraphic(_:)): act = .delete
59	        case #selector(restoreGraphicVersion(_:)): act = .restore
60	        default: return nil
61	        }
62	        guard let document = document else { return false }
63	        return GraphicFileSheetController.isOffered(act, in: document)
64	    }
65	}

3	/// The menu bar's graphics rows (road map 10's G5b; spec §11 G-45): the
4	/// Insert menu, and Help ▸ Graphics Reference's action; and File's three
5	/// graphic-file items (spec §11 G-30, issue batch B84). Insert holds

1	// app/Sources/AgentServer+GraphicFiles.swift — `delete_graphic`,
2	// `rename_graphic` and `restore_graphic` (issue #103, issue batch B84; spec
3	// §11 G-27, G-28, G-29): a module of the package's `graphics/` deleted,
4	// renamed, or one of its kept texts put back, through the three bodies in
5	// `ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift` — the SAME bodies File ▸ Delete
6	// Graphic…, Rename Graphic… and Restore Graphic Version… run through their
7	// sheet (`GraphicFileSheetController.swift`, spec §11 G-30), so the two
8	// doors refuse in the same sentences.
9	//
10	// All three are app-state tools: `project` only from the envelope, no
11	// `scope`. They run on MAIN — each body ends its file act in ONE
12	// synchronous `rescan()`, so the registry has compiled what the folder holds
13	// before the reply is built — and are never called from a
14	// `.graphicsDidChange` observer (`drain()` is not re-entrant). A file act is
15	// not undoable and never dirty (G-3); a rename's clips are ONE undo step,
16	// "Rename Graphic", and Undo renames the file back (G-28 (e)).
17	//
18	// `kept` in every answer is the module's kept revisions, newest first
19	// (G-29 (e)).
20	
21	import Foundation
22	
23	extension AgentServer {
24	
25	    static let keptNote = "not undoable; the text it replaced is kept (the last 10 per module) "
26	        + "— restore_graphic brings it back"
27	
28	    /// `delete_graphic` — UI path: File ▸ Delete Graphic…,
29	    /// `EditorViewController.deleteGraphic(_:)`
30	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicFiles.swift`).
31	    func deleteGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
32	        let document = try target(a)
33	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
34	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
35	        let revision = try graphicFileAct { try document.deleteGraphic(named: name) }
36	        return try jsonResult([
37	            "ok": true, "name": name, "revision": revision,
38	            "kept": store.kept(named: name).map(\.revision),
39	            "note": "not undoable; the deleted text is kept (the last 10 per module) — "
40	                + "restore_graphic brings it back",
41	        ])
42	    }
43	
44	    /// `rename_graphic` — UI path: File ▸ Rename Graphic…,
45	    /// `EditorViewController.renameGraphic(_:)`
46	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicFiles.swift`).
47	    ///
48	    /// The clips' `set_graphic {name}` ops go through `performGroupedEdit`
49	    /// as ONE step; with no clip drawn by the module no edit is made.
50	    func renameGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
51	        let document = try target(a)
52	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
53	        let to = try requiredString(a, "to")
54	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
55	        let clips = try graphicFileAct {
56	            try document.renameGraphic(named: name, to: to) {
57	                try self.performGroupedEdit(document, "Rename Graphic", $0)
58	            }
59	        }
60	        return try jsonResult([
61	            "ok": true, "name": to, "renamed_from": name, "clips": clips.map { Int($0) },
62	            "revision": store.module(named: to)?.revision ?? NSNull(),
63	            "kept": store.kept(named: to).map(\.revision),
64	            "note": "the file rename is not an undo step of its own and does not mark the "
65	                + "project edited; the clips' new name is one step, Rename Graphic, and undo "
66	                + "of it renames the file back",
67	        ])
68	    }
69	
70	    /// `restore_graphic` — UI path: File ▸ Restore Graphic Version…,
71	    /// `EditorViewController.restoreGraphicVersion(_:)`
72	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicFiles.swift`), which restores the newest
73	    /// kept text.
74	    ///
75	    /// Answers the compile of the restored text, as `write_graphic` does.
76	    func restoreGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
77	        let document = try target(a)
78	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
79	        let revision = try stringArg(a, "revision")
80	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
81	        let restored = try graphicFileAct {
82	            try document.restoreGraphic(named: name, revision: revision)
83	        }
84	        var result = moduleReport(named: name, document)
85	        result["name"] = name
86	        result["restored"] = restored
87	        result["kept"] = store.kept(named: name).map(\.revision)
88	        result["note"] = Self.keptNote
89	        return try jsonResult(result)
90	    }
91	
92	    /// A body's `ReelCoreError` as the tool's own error, its sentence kept.
93	    private func graphicFileAct<T>(_ body: () throws -> T) throws -> T {
94	        do {
95	            return try body()
96	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
97	            throw ToolError(message: error.message)
98	        }
99	    }
100	}

1	// app/Sources/LayerRenderersGraphic.swift — a `graphic` recipe layer drawn
2	// (road map 10 §5d, G3b): the registry's compiled module for the layer's
3	// key → the module's SVG for the frame → a raster at the layer's own size
4	// (G-7) → a premultiplied BGRA texture, the one layout `Compositor.metal`
5	// samples.
6	//
7	// **The texture key is the SVG TEXT**, not the recipe's hash — a departure
8	// from `LayerRenderers.swift`'s "the recipe's hash is the whole key", made
9	// by design §5d: the module is JavaScript the user edits, so the same hash
10	// can draw differently after a save, and the SVG is what the pixels are a
11	// function of (with the size and the library's fonts and assets). A frame
12	// whose SVG repeats — a hold, a static graphic — skips the raster.
13	//
14	// **The props and ctx are the core's own JSON text** (`props_json` and
15	// `ctx_json`), handed to the engine untouched: the engine overlays the
16	// module's defaults under the stored props (G-4), and warns about a stale
17	// key or a wrong type rather than refusing.
18	//
19	// **A graphic that fails draws its error card** (G-8, G3c): no module of
20	// that name, a module that did not compile, a throw or a timeout from the
21	// draw, a raster the engine refused. The card is keyed by its own TEXT in
22	// the same graphic pool, so a failed frame never serves the last good
23	// frame's texture and a later good frame never serves the card. Each
24	// failure and each warning is RECORDED against the recipe key — kept only
25	// by a pinned offline key (`GraphicRegistry.pin`), a no-op for a preview
26	// key. A raster's warnings ride in `Rendered.warnings`, so a pool hit still
27	// reports them. Only a key with no set (the slate) and an upload that fails
28	// answer nil.
29	
30	import AppKit
31	import CoreText
32	import CryptoKit
33	import Metal
34	
35	extension LayerRenderers {
36	
37	    /// The texture for a `graphic` recipe layer at `size` — the graphic, or
38	    /// its error card — or nil when `recipeKey` has no set.
39	    func graphic(
40	        name: String, frame: Int, propsJSON: String, ctxJSON: String,
41	        size: CGSize, recipeKey: Int
42	    ) -> Rendered? {
43	        guard let resolved = GraphicRegistry.shared.resolve(recipeKey) else { return nil }
44	        let set = resolved.set
45	        let module: GraphicModule
46	        switch set.modules[name] {
47	        case nil:
48	            let missing = GraphicDiagnostic.noModule(name)
49	            return failed(name, frame: frame, [missing], size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
50	        case .failed(let diagnostics, _)?:
51	            return failed(name, frame: nil, diagnostics, size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
52	        case .compiled(let compiled, _, _, _)?:
53	            module = compiled
54	        }
55	        let drawn: (svg: String, warnings: [GraphicDiagnostic])
56	        do {
57	            drawn = try module.svg(
58	                frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: ctxJSON,
59	                budgetMs: resolved.budgetMs)
60	        } catch {
61	            return failed(
62	                name, frame: frame, GraphicDiagnostic.of(error), size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
63	        }
64	        if !drawn.warnings.isEmpty {
65	            GraphicRegistry.shared.record(
66	                GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: drawn.warnings),
67	                for: recipeKey)
68	        }
69	        let width = Int(size.width), height = Int(size.height)
70	        let key = LayerRenderers.textureKey(
71	            svg: drawn.svg, width: width, height: height, libraryVersion: set.libraryVersion)
72	        let slot = GraphicPrefetch.Slot(
73	            name: name, frame: frame, width: width, height: height, propsJSON: propsJSON,
74	            ctxJSON: ctxJSON)
75	        var refused: [GraphicDiagnostic]?
76	        var made = false
77	        let rendered = cached(key, graphic: true) {
78	            made = true
79	            let raster: GraphicRaster
80	            do {
81	                if let prefetched = GraphicPrefetch.shared.take(
82	                    recipeKey, slot: slot, textureKey: key)
83	                {
84	                    raster = try prefetched.get()
85	                } else {
86	                    raster = try set.library.rasterize(drawn.svg, width: width, height: height)
87	                }
88	            } catch {
89	                refused = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
90	                return nil
91	            }
92	            GraphicPrefetch.shared.keep(recipeKey, textureKey: key, raster: raster)
93	            guard var uploaded = self.upload(raster) else { return nil }
94	            uploaded.warnings = raster.warnings
95	            return uploaded
96	        }
97	        if !made { GraphicPrefetch.shared.discard(recipeKey, slot: slot, textureKey: key) }
98	        if let refused = refused {
99	            return failed(name, frame: frame, refused, size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
100	        }
101	        guard let rendered = rendered else { return nil }
102	        if !rendered.warnings.isEmpty {
103	            GraphicRegistry.shared.record(
104	                GraphicReport(
105	                    name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: rendered.warnings),
106	                for: recipeKey)
107	        }
108	        return rendered
109	    }
110	
111	    /// A failure recorded against `recipeKey` and drawn as its error card.
112	    private func failed(
113	        _ name: String, frame: Int?, _ diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic], size: CGSize,
114	        recipeKey: Int
115	    ) -> Rendered? {
116	        GraphicRegistry.shared.record(
117	            GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics),
118	            for: recipeKey)
119	        return errorCard(
120	            text: Self.errorCardText(name: name, frame: frame, diagnostic: diagnostics.first),
121	            size: size)
122	    }
123	
124	    /// The card's lines: `<name> · frame <N>` (or `· does not compile`), the
125	    /// message, and `line L, column C` when the diagnostic has a line.
126	    static func errorCardText(name: String, frame: Int?, diagnostic: GraphicDiagnostic?) -> String {
127	        var lines = [frame.map { "\(name) · frame \($0)" } ?? "\(name) · does not compile"]
128	        if let diagnostic = diagnostic {
129	            lines.append(diagnostic.message)
130	            if let line = diagnostic.line {
131	                lines.append("line \(line)" + (diagnostic.column.map { ", column \($0)" } ?? ""))
132	            }
133	        }
134	        return lines.joined(separator: "\n")
135	    }
136	
137	    /// The error card (G-8): dark red, a 2 px bright red border, `text` in
138	    /// white mono inset by three times its point size. Keyed by the text and
139	    /// the size in the graphic pool.
140	    func errorCard(text: String, size: CGSize) -> Rendered? {
141	        let digest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(text.utf8))
142	        let hex = digest.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
143	        let key = "graphic-error:" + hex + ":"
144	            + "\(Int(size.width.rounded()))x\(Int(size.height.rounded()))"
145	        return cached(key, graphic: true) {
146	            guard let context = LayerRenderers.bitmap(size) else { return nil }
147	            let bounds = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: context.width, height: context.height)
148	            Self.paintErrorCard(text, in: context, bounds: bounds)
149	            return self.upload(context, size: bounds.size)
150	        }
151	    }
152	
153	    /// The card's drawing, into `bounds` of an unflipped `context`: the one
154	    /// painter, shared by `errorCard` and `render_graphic`'s contact sheet.
155	    static func paintErrorCard(_ text: String, in context: CGContext, bounds: CGRect) {
156	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 230 / 255, green: 40 / 255, blue: 40 / 255, alpha: 1))
157	        context.fill(bounds)
158	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 64 / 255, green: 8 / 255, blue: 8 / 255, alpha: 1))
159	        context.fill(bounds.insetBy(dx: 2, dy: 2))
160	        let point = max(11, (min(bounds.width, bounds.height) / 28).rounded())
161	        let rect = bounds.insetBy(dx: 3 * point, dy: 3 * point)
162	        if rect.width > 0, rect.height > 0 {
163	            let attributed = NSAttributedString(
164	                string: text,
165	                attributes: [.font: DS.mono(point), .foregroundColor: NSColor.white])
166	            let framesetter = CTFramesetterCreateWithAttributedString(attributed)
167	            let frame = CTFramesetterCreateFrame(
168	                framesetter, CFRange(location: 0, length: 0),
169	                CGPath(rect: rect, transform: nil), nil)
170	            CTFrameDraw(frame, context)
171	        }
172	    }
173	
174	    /// `"graphic:" + SHA-256(svg) + ":" + w×h + ":" + libraryVersion`.
175	    static func textureKey(svg: String, width: Int, height: Int, libraryVersion: String) -> String {
176	        let digest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(svg.utf8))
177	        let hex = digest.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
178	        return "graphic:" + hex + ":" + "\(width)x\(height)" + ":" + libraryVersion
179	    }
180	
181	    /// Uploads an engine raster — already premultiplied BGRA, rows
182	    /// `stride` bytes apart, row 0 the top — to a `.bgra8Unorm` texture of
183	    /// the raster's own size.
184	    func upload(_ raster: GraphicRaster) -> Rendered? {
185	        guard raster.width > 0, raster.height > 0 else { return nil }
186	        let descriptor = MTLTextureDescriptor.texture2DDescriptor(
187	            pixelFormat: .bgra8Unorm, width: raster.width, height: raster.height,
188	            mipmapped: false)
189	        descriptor.usage = [.shaderRead]
190	        descriptor.storageMode = .managed
191	        guard let texture = device.makeTexture(descriptor: descriptor) else { return nil }
192	        raster.bgra.withUnsafeBytes { bytes in
193	            guard let base = bytes.baseAddress else { return }
194	            texture.replace(
195	                region: MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, raster.width, raster.height), mipmapLevel: 0,
196	                withBytes: base, bytesPerRow: raster.stride)
197	        }
198	        return Rendered(
199	            texture: texture, size: CGSize(width: raster.width, height: raster.height))
200	    }
201	}
202	
203	extension GraphicPrefetch {
204	    /// One graphic layer's inputs — exactly what `LayerRenderers.graphic` is
205	    /// called with. Member order is load-bearing (`graphics_proof.py`'s
206	    /// `frame-plus-one` anchor in `LayerRenderersGraphic.swift`).
207	    struct Slot: Hashable {
208	        let name: String
209	        let frame: Int
210	        let width: Int
211	        let height: Int
212	        let propsJSON: String
213	        let ctxJSON: String
214	    }
215	}

1	// app/Sources/GraphicFileSheetController.swift — File ▸ Rename Graphic…,
2	// Delete Graphic… and Restore Graphic Version… (spec §11 G-30; issue #103,
3	// issue batch B84): ONE small sheet for the three, a pop-up of the
4	// project's graphics over the three bodies in
5	// `ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift` — the bodies `rename_graphic`,
6	// `delete_graphic` and `restore_graphic` call, so both doors refuse in the
7	// same sentences.
8	//
9	// **No second implementation.** Every act is one call of a body
10	// (`perform`); nothing here reaches a `GraphicStore` writer, an op or an
11	// undo registration, and no sentence a body throws is rewritten, prefixed
12	// or predicted: a refusal is shown word for word in `messageLabel` and the
13	// sheet stays up. The two guards written here name the CALL (spec §11
14	// D2-1): a new name that is empty or unchanged (`canConfirm`), and an item
15	// with nothing to list (`isOffered`).
16	//
17	// **`perform` runs from the button's action only**: each body ends in
18	// `rescan()`, which must never run from a `.graphicsDidChange` observer.
19	// Rename's `apply` is `performGroupedEdit`, never `applyEdit`: the clips'
20	// new name is one CLOSED undo step wherever the action was sent from, it
21	// does not throw, and the body's own re-read moves the file back when the
22	// edit was refused.
23	
24	import AppKit
25	
26	/// One of the three file acts a person can ask for.
27	enum GraphicFileAct: CaseIterable {
28	    case rename, delete, restore
29	
30	    /// The File menu's title.
31	    var menuTitle: String {
32	        switch self {
33	        case .rename: return "Rename Graphic…"
34	        case .delete: return "Delete Graphic…"
35	        case .restore: return "Restore Graphic Version…"
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    /// The sheet's title: the menu's without its "…".
40	    var sheetTitle: String { String(menuTitle.dropLast()) }
41	
42	    var confirmTitle: String {
43	        switch self {
44	        case .rename: return "Rename"
45	        case .delete: return "Delete"
46	        case .restore: return "Restore"
47	        }
48	    }
49	
50	    /// The sentence under the title (spec §11 G-30 (c), word for word).
51	    var hint: String {
52	        switch self {
53	        case .rename:
54	            return "Every clip that uses the graphic follows its new name, on the timeline and "
55	                + "inside nests. Undo renames it back when a clip uses it; a graphic no clip "
56	                + "uses is renamed back by renaming it again."
57	        case .delete:
58	            return "A graphic that clips still use cannot be deleted. Its code is kept with its "
59	                + "earlier versions, so Restore Graphic Version… brings it back. Deleting is "
60	                + "not an Undo step."
61	        case .restore:
62	            return "Puts back the newest kept version of the graphic's code. If the graphic has "
63	                + "code now, that code is kept in its place, so restoring again returns to "
64	                + "where you were. Restoring is not an Undo step."
65	        }
66	    }
67	}
68	
69	/// One row of the sheet's pop-up.
70	struct GraphicFileChoice: Equatable {
71	    let name: String
72	    /// No `graphics/<name>.js`: a deleted module that still has kept texts.
73	    let deleted: Bool
74	    /// How many texts of it are kept.
75	    let kept: Int
76	
77	    var title: String { deleted ? "\(name) (deleted)" : name }
78	}
79	
80	final class GraphicFileSheetController: NSViewController, NSTextFieldDelegate {
81	    /// Weak, like every sheet's back-reference.
82	    private weak var document: ProjectDocument?
83	    private let act: GraphicFileAct
84	    private let choices: [GraphicFileChoice]
85	    private let opening: String?
86	
87	    private let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
88	    private let nameField = NSTextField(string: "")
89	    private let keptLabel = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
90	    private let messageLabel = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
91	    private let confirmButton: NSButton
92	
93	    private static let controlWidth: CGFloat = 240
94	
95	    // MARK: - The model
96	
97	    /// The rows an act lists, by name: the folder's modules for Rename and
98	    /// Delete; every name with a kept text for Restore, deleted modules
99	    /// included. Empty with no store.
100	    static func choices(for act: GraphicFileAct, in document: ProjectDocument)
101	        -> [GraphicFileChoice]
102	    {
103	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else { return [] }
104	        let names: [String]
105	        switch act {
106	        case .rename, .delete:
107	            return store.scan.modules.keys.sorted().map {
108	                GraphicFileChoice(name: $0, deleted: false, kept: store.kept(named: $0).count)
109	            }
110	        case .restore:
111	            names = store.keptNames()
112	        }
113	        return names.map {
114	            GraphicFileChoice(
115	                name: $0, deleted: !store.holdsModule(named: $0),
116	                kept: store.kept(named: $0).count)
117	        }
118	    }
119	
120	    /// Whether the menu item is live: something to list, and for Rename no
121	    /// nest open (spec §11 G-28 (g)). A validator asks this on every menu
122	    /// open, so it answers whether `choices` would be empty without
123	    /// building them: Rename and Delete from the last scan, Restore from
124	    /// `keptNames()`, and no row's `kept` count is read.
125	    static func isOffered(_ act: GraphicFileAct, in document: ProjectDocument) -> Bool {
126	        if act == .rename, document.scope != nil { return false }

4	/// (spec §11 G-30; issue #103, issue batch B84): three menu actions, the
5	/// one place their sheet goes up, and their validator arm. The sheet,
6	/// `GraphicFileSheetController`, calls the bodies the three tools call
7	/// (`ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift`); nothing here writes a file or
8	/// applies an op.
9	///
10	/// **Where a sheet opens** (G-30 (d)): Rename and Restore on the graphic of
11	/// the ONE selected clip when it is a row, else the first; Delete always on
12	/// the first. `selectedClips` is the open scope's selection.
13	///
14	/// **When an item is live** (G-30 (f)): something to list, and for Rename
15	/// no nest open. `validateGraphicMenuAction`'s default arm forwards here;
16	/// the frozen file's validator has already answered false with a sheet
17	/// attached. On every menu open Rename and Delete ask the last scan, and
18	/// Restore `keptNames()`: file names under `graphics/history/`, no bytes.
19	extension EditorViewController {
20	
21	    /// File ▸ Rename Graphic… — `rename_graphic`'s body.
22	    @objc func renameGraphic(_ sender: Any?) {
23	        presentGraphicFileSheet(.rename)
24	    }
25	
26	    /// File ▸ Delete Graphic… — `delete_graphic`'s body.
27	    @objc func deleteGraphic(_ sender: Any?) {
28	        presentGraphicFileSheet(.delete)
29	    }
30	
31	    /// File ▸ Restore Graphic Version… — `restore_graphic`'s body, the
32	    /// newest kept text.
33	    @objc func restoreGraphicVersion(_ sender: Any?) {
34	        presentGraphicFileSheet(.restore)
35	    }
36	
37	    /// The sheet for `act`, or a beep when the item has nothing to offer.
38	    func presentGraphicFileSheet(_ act: GraphicFileAct) {
39	        guard let document = document, GraphicFileSheetController.isOffered(act, in: document)
40	        else {
41	            NSSound.beep()
42	            return
43	        }
44	        let choices = GraphicFileSheetController.choices(for: act, in: document)
45	        let clips = selectedClips
46	        let selected = clips.count == 1 ? clips[0].graphic?.name : nil
47	        let sheet = GraphicFileSheetController(
48	            document: document, act: act, choices: choices,
49	            opening: GraphicFileSheetController.opening(for: act, selected: selected, in: choices))
50	        presentAsSheet(sheet)

53	    /// The menu arm for the three; nil for any other action.
54	    func validateGraphicFileAction(_ action: Selector) -> Bool? {
55	        let act: GraphicFileAct
56	        switch action {
57	        case #selector(renameGraphic(_:)): act = .rename
58	        case #selector(deleteGraphic(_:)): act = .delete
59	        case #selector(restoreGraphicVersion(_:)): act = .restore
60	        default: return nil

2	// `rename_graphic` and `restore_graphic` (issue #103, issue batch B84; spec
3	// §11 G-27, G-28, G-29): a module of the package's `graphics/` deleted,
4	// renamed, or one of its kept texts put back, through the three bodies in
5	// `ProjectDocument+GraphicFiles.swift` — the SAME bodies File ▸ Delete
6	// Graphic…, Rename Graphic… and Restore Graphic Version… run through their
7	// sheet (`GraphicFileSheetController.swift`, spec §11 G-30), so the two
8	// doors refuse in the same sentences.
9	//
10	// All three are app-state tools: `project` only from the envelope, no
11	// `scope`. They run on MAIN — each body ends its file act in ONE
12	// synchronous `rescan()`, so the registry has compiled what the folder holds
13	// before the reply is built — and are never called from a
14	// `.graphicsDidChange` observer (`drain()` is not re-entrant). A file act is
15	// not undoable and never dirty (G-3); a rename's clips are ONE undo step,
16	// "Rename Graphic", and Undo renames the file back (G-28 (e)).
17	//
18	// `kept` in every answer is the module's kept revisions, newest first
19	// (G-29 (e)).
20	
21	import Foundation
22	
23	extension AgentServer {
24	
25	    static let keptNote = "not undoable; the text it replaced is kept (the last 10 per module) "
26	        + "— restore_graphic brings it back"
27	
28	    /// `delete_graphic` — UI path: File ▸ Delete Graphic…,
29	    /// `EditorViewController.deleteGraphic(_:)`
30	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicFiles.swift`).
31	    func deleteGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
32	        let document = try target(a)
33	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
34	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
35	        let revision = try graphicFileAct { try document.deleteGraphic(named: name) }
36	        return try jsonResult([
37	            "ok": true, "name": name, "revision": revision,
38	            "kept": store.kept(named: name).map(\.revision),
39	            "note": "not undoable; the deleted text is kept (the last 10 per module) — "
40	                + "restore_graphic brings it back",
41	        ])
42	    }
43	
44	    /// `rename_graphic` — UI path: File ▸ Rename Graphic…,
45	    /// `EditorViewController.renameGraphic(_:)`
46	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicFiles.swift`).
47	    ///
48	    /// The clips' `set_graphic {name}` ops go through `performGroupedEdit`
49	    /// as ONE step; with no clip drawn by the module no edit is made.
50	    func renameGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
51	        let document = try target(a)
52	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
53	        let to = try requiredString(a, "to")
54	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
55	        let clips = try graphicFileAct {
56	            try document.renameGraphic(named: name, to: to) {
57	                try self.performGroupedEdit(document, "Rename Graphic", $0)
58	            }
59	        }
60	        return try jsonResult([
61	            "ok": true, "name": to, "renamed_from": name, "clips": clips.map { Int($0) },
62	            "revision": store.module(named: to)?.revision ?? NSNull(),
63	            "kept": store.kept(named: to).map(\.revision),
64	            "note": "the file rename is not an undo step of its own and does not mark the "
65	                + "project edited; the clips' new name is one step, Rename Graphic, and undo "
66	                + "of it renames the file back",
67	        ])
68	    }
69	
70	    /// `restore_graphic` — UI path: File ▸ Restore Graphic Version…,
71	    /// `EditorViewController.restoreGraphicVersion(_:)`
72	    /// (`EditorViewController+GraphicFiles.swift`), which restores the newest
73	    /// kept text.
74	    ///
75	    /// Answers the compile of the restored text, as `write_graphic` does.
76	    func restoreGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
77	        let document = try target(a)
78	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
79	        let revision = try stringArg(a, "revision")
80	        let store = try graphicStore(document)
81	        let restored = try graphicFileAct {
82	            try document.restoreGraphic(named: name, revision: revision)
83	        }
84	        var result = moduleReport(named: name, document)
85	        result["name"] = name
86	        result["restored"] = restored
87	        result["kept"] = store.kept(named: name).map(\.revision)
88	        result["note"] = Self.keptNote
89	        return try jsonResult(result)
90	    }
91	
92	    /// A body's `ReelCoreError` as the tool's own error, its sentence kept.
93	    private func graphicFileAct<T>(_ body: () throws -> T) throws -> T {
94	        do {
95	            return try body()
96	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
97	            throw ToolError(message: error.message)
98	        }
99	    }
100	}

1	// app/Sources/LayerRenderersGraphic.swift — a `graphic` recipe layer drawn
2	// (road map 10 §5d, G3b): the registry's compiled module for the layer's
3	// key → the module's SVG for the frame → a raster at the layer's own size
4	// (G-7) → a premultiplied BGRA texture, the one layout `Compositor.metal`
5	// samples.
6	//
7	// **The texture key is the SVG TEXT**, not the recipe's hash — a departure
8	// from `LayerRenderers.swift`'s "the recipe's hash is the whole key", made
9	// by design §5d: the module is JavaScript the user edits, so the same hash
10	// can draw differently after a save, and the SVG is what the pixels are a
11	// function of (with the size and the library's fonts and assets). A frame
12	// whose SVG repeats — a hold, a static graphic — skips the raster.
13	//
14	// **The props and ctx are the core's own JSON text** (`props_json` and
15	// `ctx_json`), handed to the engine untouched: the engine overlays the
16	// module's defaults under the stored props (G-4), and warns about a stale
17	// key or a wrong type rather than refusing.
18	//
19	// **A graphic that fails draws its error card** (G-8, G3c): no module of
20	// that name, a module that did not compile, a throw or a timeout from the
21	// draw, a raster the engine refused. The card is keyed by its own TEXT in
22	// the same graphic pool, so a failed frame never serves the last good
23	// frame's texture and a later good frame never serves the card. Each
24	// failure and each warning is RECORDED against the recipe key — kept only
25	// by a pinned offline key (`GraphicRegistry.pin`), a no-op for a preview
26	// key. A raster's warnings ride in `Rendered.warnings`, so a pool hit still
27	// reports them. Only a key with no set (the slate) and an upload that fails
28	// answer nil.
29	
30	import AppKit
31	import CoreText
32	import CryptoKit
33	import Metal
34	
35	extension LayerRenderers {
36	
37	    /// The texture for a `graphic` recipe layer at `size` — the graphic, or
38	    /// its error card — or nil when `recipeKey` has no set.
39	    func graphic(
40	        name: String, frame: Int, propsJSON: String, ctxJSON: String,
41	        size: CGSize, recipeKey: Int
42	    ) -> Rendered? {
43	        guard let resolved = GraphicRegistry.shared.resolve(recipeKey) else { return nil }
44	        let set = resolved.set
45	        let module: GraphicModule
46	        switch set.modules[name] {
47	        case nil:
48	            let missing = GraphicDiagnostic.noModule(name)
49	            return failed(name, frame: frame, [missing], size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
50	        case .failed(let diagnostics, _)?:
51	            return failed(name, frame: nil, diagnostics, size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
52	        case .compiled(let compiled, _, _, _)?:
53	            module = compiled
54	        }
55	        let drawn: (svg: String, warnings: [GraphicDiagnostic])
56	        do {
57	            drawn = try module.svg(
58	                frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: ctxJSON,
59	                budgetMs: resolved.budgetMs)
60	        } catch {
61	            return failed(
62	                name, frame: frame, GraphicDiagnostic.of(error), size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
63	        }
64	        if !drawn.warnings.isEmpty {
65	            GraphicRegistry.shared.record(
66	                GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: drawn.warnings),
67	                for: recipeKey)
68	        }
69	        let width = Int(size.width), height = Int(size.height)
70	        let key = LayerRenderers.textureKey(
71	            svg: drawn.svg, width: width, height: height, libraryVersion: set.libraryVersion)
72	        let slot = GraphicPrefetch.Slot(
73	            name: name, frame: frame, width: width, height: height, propsJSON: propsJSON,
74	            ctxJSON: ctxJSON)
75	        var refused: [GraphicDiagnostic]?
76	        var made = false
77	        let rendered = cached(key, graphic: true) {
78	            made = true
79	            let raster: GraphicRaster
80	            do {
81	                if let prefetched = GraphicPrefetch.shared.take(
82	                    recipeKey, slot: slot, textureKey: key)
83	                {
84	                    raster = try prefetched.get()
85	                } else {
86	                    raster = try set.library.rasterize(drawn.svg, width: width, height: height)
87	                }
88	            } catch {
89	                refused = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
90	                return nil
91	            }
92	            GraphicPrefetch.shared.keep(recipeKey, textureKey: key, raster: raster)
93	            guard var uploaded = self.upload(raster) else { return nil }
94	            uploaded.warnings = raster.warnings
95	            return uploaded
96	        }
97	        if !made { GraphicPrefetch.shared.discard(recipeKey, slot: slot, textureKey: key) }
98	        if let refused = refused {
99	            return failed(name, frame: frame, refused, size: size, recipeKey: recipeKey)
100	        }
101	        guard let rendered = rendered else { return nil }
102	        if !rendered.warnings.isEmpty {
103	            GraphicRegistry.shared.record(
104	                GraphicReport(
105	                    name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: rendered.warnings),
106	                for: recipeKey)
107	        }
108	        return rendered
109	    }
110	
111	    /// A failure recorded against `recipeKey` and drawn as its error card.
112	    private func failed(
113	        _ name: String, frame: Int?, _ diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic], size: CGSize,
114	        recipeKey: Int
115	    ) -> Rendered? {
116	        GraphicRegistry.shared.record(
117	            GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics),
118	            for: recipeKey)
119	        return errorCard(
120	            text: Self.errorCardText(name: name, frame: frame, diagnostic: diagnostics.first),
121	            size: size)
122	    }
123	
124	    /// The card's lines: `<name> · frame <N>` (or `· does not compile`), the
125	    /// message, and `line L, column C` when the diagnostic has a line.
126	    static func errorCardText(name: String, frame: Int?, diagnostic: GraphicDiagnostic?) -> String {
127	        var lines = [frame.map { "\(name) · frame \($0)" } ?? "\(name) · does not compile"]
128	        if let diagnostic = diagnostic {
129	            lines.append(diagnostic.message)
130	            if let line = diagnostic.line {
131	                lines.append("line \(line)" + (diagnostic.column.map { ", column \($0)" } ?? ""))
132	            }
133	        }
134	        return lines.joined(separator: "\n")
135	    }
136	
137	    /// The error card (G-8): dark red, a 2 px bright red border, `text` in
138	    /// white mono inset by three times its point size. Keyed by the text and
139	    /// the size in the graphic pool.
140	    func errorCard(text: String, size: CGSize) -> Rendered? {
141	        let digest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(text.utf8))
142	        let hex = digest.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
143	        let key = "graphic-error:" + hex + ":"
144	            + "\(Int(size.width.rounded()))x\(Int(size.height.rounded()))"
145	        return cached(key, graphic: true) {
146	            guard let context = LayerRenderers.bitmap(size) else { return nil }
147	            let bounds = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: context.width, height: context.height)
148	            Self.paintErrorCard(text, in: context, bounds: bounds)
149	            return self.upload(context, size: bounds.size)

155	    static func paintErrorCard(_ text: String, in context: CGContext, bounds: CGRect) {
156	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 230 / 255, green: 40 / 255, blue: 40 / 255, alpha: 1))
157	        context.fill(bounds)
158	        context.setFillColor(CGColor(srgbRed: 64 / 255, green: 8 / 255, blue: 8 / 255, alpha: 1))
159	        context.fill(bounds.insetBy(dx: 2, dy: 2))
160	        let point = max(11, (min(bounds.width, bounds.height) / 28).rounded())
161	        let rect = bounds.insetBy(dx: 3 * point, dy: 3 * point)
162	        if rect.width > 0, rect.height > 0 {
163	            let attributed = NSAttributedString(
164	                string: text,
165	                attributes: [.font: DS.mono(point), .foregroundColor: NSColor.white])
166	            let framesetter = CTFramesetterCreateWithAttributedString(attributed)
167	            let frame = CTFramesetterCreateFrame(
168	                framesetter, CFRange(location: 0, length: 0),
169	                CGPath(rect: rect, transform: nil), nil)
170	            CTFrameDraw(frame, context)
171	        }
172	    }

174	    /// `"graphic:" + SHA-256(svg) + ":" + w×h + ":" + libraryVersion`.
175	    static func textureKey(svg: String, width: Int, height: Int, libraryVersion: String) -> String {
176	        let digest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(svg.utf8))
177	        let hex = digest.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
178	        return "graphic:" + hex + ":" + "\(width)x\(height)" + ":" + libraryVersion
