181	    /// Uploads an engine raster — already premultiplied BGRA, rows
182	    /// `stride` bytes apart, row 0 the top — to a `.bgra8Unorm` texture of
183	    /// the raster's own size.
184	    func upload(_ raster: GraphicRaster) -> Rendered? {
185	        guard raster.width > 0, raster.height > 0 else { return nil }
186	        let descriptor = MTLTextureDescriptor.texture2DDescriptor(
187	            pixelFormat: .bgra8Unorm, width: raster.width, height: raster.height,
188	            mipmapped: false)
189	        descriptor.usage = [.shaderRead]
190	        descriptor.storageMode = .managed
191	        guard let texture = device.makeTexture(descriptor: descriptor) else { return nil }
192	        raster.bgra.withUnsafeBytes { bytes in
193	            guard let base = bytes.baseAddress else { return }
194	            texture.replace(
195	                region: MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, raster.width, raster.height), mipmapLevel: 0,
196	                withBytes: base, bytesPerRow: raster.stride)
197	        }
198	        return Rendered(
199	            texture: texture, size: CGSize(width: raster.width, height: raster.height))
200	    }

1	// app/Sources/GraphicPrefetch.swift — an export's graphics, and a playing
2	// preview's, rasterized AHEAD of the compositor, on worker threads (spec §11
3	// G-26, G-36 and G-37, issue #127).
4	//
5	// **The compositor stays the one writer.** A worker runs a frame's graphic
6	// modules and rasterizes their SVG into a slot; the compositor still runs
7	// `svg` itself, records every warning and failure and draws every error card
8	// (G-8), and takes a slot's raster only on a pool miss and only when the
9	// worker's texture key equals its own (`LayerRenderersGraphic.swift`). So a
10	// worker can be wrong, late or absent and the file is still the serial
11	// path's, byte for byte.
12	//
13	// **Where it runs.** An `ExportWriter` export with a pinned set and a
14	// graphic in range (`Exporter.startGraphicPrefetch`), and a preview playing
15	// forward over a project that draws a graphic, on the document's own key
16	// (`Playback+Prefetch.swift`, G-36); never GIF/APNG, a one-frame render or a
17	// paused or reversing preview. `FrameJobGraphicPrefetchOff` (YES) is the
18	// measurement switch back to the serial path for both.
19	//
20	// **The grid.** A worker walks `range.start + i × frameDuration` on the
21	// export's own key: the core snaps the start onto the export's own grid
22	// from 0, at the export's rate after any override, so those are the
23	// instants the writer asks the compositor for. A playback session's grid
24	// starts at the seek target or the playhead, snapped down onto the
25	// composition's own grid from 0. A worker reads only through
26	// `RecipeSource.recipe(for:at:)` and `GraphicRegistry.resolve` — the
27	// export's PINNED set (G-13), or the document's — and never records a report.
28	//
29	// **Following.** A playback session `follows`: the compositor reports every
30	// request's time (`reach`), a worker never claims a frame at or before the
31	// last one reached (the frames passed over are `skipped`), and a held entry
32	// of an earlier frame goes as unused. A request outside the session's range
33	// is not followed, and a seek's session follows nothing until a request
34	// lands in its first `armFrames` frames: a seek installs the session before
35	// AVFoundation cancels the old position's requests, and those still served
36	// in between must not move the new session's floor. An export session never reads `floor`,
37	// `skipped` or `deferred`, and its log line is unchanged; a following one's
38	// appends `, playback from <start>, <skipped> skipped, <kept> kept`.
39	//
40	// **Bounds (G-37).** Bytes decide how far ahead workers go: a worker waits
41	// while the held rasters of ALL sessions reach the one process-wide budget
42	// (a quarter of physical memory, less under memory pressure), or while its
43	// session holds `entryCeiling` entries, bytes or none. A playing document's
44	// key KEEPS the frames it drew (`GraphicPrefetch+Memory.swift`): a finished
45	// raster leaving its slot goes into the kept frames, `take` answers from them
46	// before any slot, and a worker skips a texture key already kept. The kept
47	// frames fill only the room the held rasters leave.
48	//
49	// **One `NSCondition`** guards `sessions`, the kept frames, every total and
50	// every session and entry field, broadcast on every change (`CacheLedger`'s
51	// precedent). A worker never
52	// waits while it holds an unfinished entry, so the compositor's `take`, the
53	// one wait on its queue, always ends: on `done` or on `stop`. Each worker is
54	// a Foundation `Thread` with a stack above the engine's own 1 MiB; its
55	// QuickJS engines die with it.
56	
57	import CoreGraphics
58	import CoreMedia
59	import Foundation
60	
61	final class GraphicPrefetch: @unchecked Sendable {
62	    static let shared = GraphicPrefetch()
63	    /// YES draws every graphic on the compositor's queue alone.
64	    static let offDefaultsKey = "FrameJobGraphicPrefetchOff"
65	    /// Above `graphic::STACK_BYTES` (1 MiB).
66	    static let workerStackBytes = 8 << 20
67	    static var workerCount: Int { max(1, ProcessInfo.processInfo.activeProcessorCount - 1) }
68	    /// The entries one session holds at most, bytes or none (G-37 (a)).
69	    static let entryCeiling = 1024
70	
71	    /// One slot's raster as a worker made it. Guarded by `condition`.
72	    private final class Entry {
73	        let index: Int
74	        var bytes: Int
75	        var done = false
76	        /// Set by the worker's same-texture shortcut: the raster is left to
77	        /// the compositor's pool, from an earlier frame's entry.
78	        var deferred = false
79	        var textureKey: String?
80	        var raster: Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>?
81	        /// A pass's later layers deferred to this entry, and their top index.
82	        var sharers = 0, sharedUpTo = 0
83	
84	        init(index: Int, bytes: Int) {
85	            self.index = index
86	            self.bytes = bytes
87	        }
88	    }
89	
90	    /// One export's prefetch. Guarded by `condition`; its workers hold it
91	    /// after `stop` has removed it from `sessions`.
92	    private final class Session: @unchecked Sendable {
93	        let key: Int
94	        let start: CMTime
95	        let frameDuration: CMTime
96	        let endTicks: Ticks
97	        let workerCount: Int
98	        /// A playback session: `reach` raises `floor`, `claim` skips past it.
99	        let follows: Bool
100	        /// A paused document's pass into its kept frames (G-38).
101	        let background: Bool
102	        var drawn = 0, alreadyKept = 0, end = "done"
103	        let startTicks: Ticks
104	        let frameTicks: Ticks
105	        /// False for a seek's session until a request lands in its first
106	        /// `armFrames` frames; `reach` follows nothing before.
107	        var armed: Bool
108	        /// The last frame index the compositor reached; -1 before any.
109	        var floor = -1
110	        var skipped = 0
111	        var next = 0
112	        var exhausted = false
113	        var stopped = false
114	        var slots: [Slot: Entry] = [:]
115	        var heldBytes = 0
116	        var liveWorkers = 0
117	        var logged = false
118	        var framesWithGraphics = 0
119	        var hits = 0
120	        var mismatched = 0
121	        var missed = 0
122	        var unused = 0
123	        /// Requests the kept frames answered while this session ran.
124	        var kept = 0
125	        /// Texture key → the SMALLEST frame index whose entry rasterizes it,
126	        /// least recently touched first; the compositor pool's capacity.
127	        var recent: [(key: String, index: Int)] = []
128	
129	        init(
130	            key: Int, range: CMTimeRange, frameDuration: CMTime, workerCount: Int, follows: Bool,
131	            seeking: Bool, background: Bool
132	        ) {
133	            self.key = key
134	            self.background = background
135	            self.start = range.start
136	            self.frameDuration = frameDuration
137	            self.endTicks = CompositionBuilder.ticks(range.end)
138	            self.workerCount = workerCount
139	            self.follows = follows
140	            self.armed = !seeking
141	            self.startTicks = CompositionBuilder.ticks(range.start)
142	            self.frameTicks = max(1, CompositionBuilder.ticks(frameDuration))
143	        }
144	
145	        func recentIndex(_ key: String) -> Int? {
146	            recent.first { $0.key == key }?.index
147	        }
148	
149	        /// `key` moved to the most recent end, at `index` when given.
150	        func touch(_ key: String, index: Int? = nil) {
151	            let kept = recentIndex(key)
152	            recent.removeAll { $0.key == key }
153	            guard let value = index ?? kept else { return }
154	            recent.append((key, value))
155	            if recent.count > LayerRenderers.graphicCacheLimit { recent.removeFirst() }
156	        }
157	    }
158	
159	    let condition = NSCondition()
160	    private var sessions: [Int: Session] = [:]
161	    /// The kept frames and the keys that keep (G-37 (c)).
162	    var kept = KeptFrames()
163	    var keeping: Set<Int> = []
164	    /// The last pass's key and grid start, and its App Nap opt-out (G-38).
165	    var aheadOrigin: (key: Int, startTicks: Ticks)?
166	    var passActivity: NSObjectProtocol?
167	    /// The system's memory-pressure level, and the dev tool's simulated one.
168	    var pressure = MemoryPressure.normal
169	    var simulatedPressure: MemoryPressure?
170	    /// Every session's held rasters: bytes, entries holding bytes, and their
171	    /// peaks since the last report that reset them.
172	    var heldTotal = 0
173	    var heldEntries = 0
174	    var heldPeakBytes = 0
175	    var heldPeakEntries = 0
176	    /// Requests the kept frames answered.
177	    var keptHits = 0
178	    var pressureSource: DispatchSourceMemoryPressure?
179	
180	    private init() {
181	        watchMemoryPressure()
182	    }
183	
184	    // MARK: - Main
185	
186	    /// Starts `key`'s workers over `range` at `frameDuration`: `follows` a
187	    /// play (G-36), `seeking` from a seek, `background` a paused pass (G-38;
188	    /// both main only). False, installing nothing, when the switch is on, `key`
189	    /// has a session, either is not positive, or (a pass) `key` does not keep
190	    /// or any session is a pass or follows.
191	    @discardableResult
192	    func start(
193	        key: Int, range: CMTimeRange, frameDuration: CMTime, follows: Bool = false,
194	        seeking: Bool = false, background: Bool = false
195	    ) -> Bool {
196	        guard !UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: Self.offDefaultsKey),
197	            range.isValid, range.start.isNumeric, range.duration.isNumeric,
198	            frameDuration.isNumeric,
199	            CMTimeCompare(range.duration, .zero) > 0, CMTimeCompare(frameDuration, .zero) > 0
200	        else { return false }
201	        if follows { stopBackground() }
202	        let count = Self.workerCount
203	        let startTicks = CompositionBuilder.ticks(range.start)
204	        condition.lock()
205	        let refused =
206	            background
207	            && (!keeping.contains(key) || sessions.values.contains { $0.background }
208	                || sessions.values.contains { $0.follows })
209	        guard sessions[key] == nil, !refused else {
210	            condition.unlock()
211	            return false
212	        }
213	        if background { beginAhead(key, startTicks: startTicks) }
214	        if follows { followAhead(key, startTicks: startTicks) }
215	        let session = Session(
216	            key: key, range: range, frameDuration: frameDuration, workerCount: count,
217	            follows: follows, seeking: seeking, background: background)
218	        session.liveWorkers = count
219	        sessions[key] = session
220	        condition.broadcast()
221	        condition.unlock()
222	        if background {
223	            NSLog("[framejob] graphic background: key %ld, from %lld, started", key, startTicks)
224	        }
225	        for _ in 0..<count {
226	            let thread = Thread { [self] in self.work(session) }
227	            thread.stackSize = Self.workerStackBytes
228	            thread.qualityOfService = background ? .utility : .userInitiated
229	            thread.name = "framejob.graphic-prefetch"
230	            thread.start()
231	        }
232	        return true
233	    }
234	
235	    /// `stop(key)` for every background session, no other. Main only.
236	    func stopBackground() {
237	        condition.lock()
238	        let keys = sessions.values.filter(\.background).map(\.key)
239	        condition.unlock()
240	        for key in keys { stop(key) }
241	    }
242	
243	    /// Ends `key`'s session: its entries unused (a keeping key's finished
244	    /// rasters kept), its workers told. Any thread; idempotent; never waits.
245	    /// A pass logs at once: nothing it draws after the stop is kept.
246	    func stop(_ key: Int) {
247	        condition.lock()
248	        guard let session = sessions.removeValue(forKey: key) else {
249	            condition.unlock()
250	            return
251	        }
252	        (session.stopped, session.end) = (true, session.exhausted ? session.end : "stopped")
253	        if session.follows { endAhead(key) }
254	        if session.background { endPassActivity() }
255	        session.unused += session.slots.count
256	        for entry in session.slots.values { release(entry, from: session) }
257	        session.slots.removeAll()
258	        condition.broadcast()
259	        let line = session.liveWorkers == 0 || session.background ? logLine(session) : nil
260	        condition.unlock()
261	        if let line = line { NSLog("%@", line) }
262	    }
263	
264	    // MARK: - The compositor's queue
265	
266	    /// A seek's session follows from the first request in this many of its
267	    /// first frames: the seek's own frame, or one just after it.
268	    static let armFrames = 4
269	
270	    /// The compositor reached `ticks` on `key`. In a following session a
271	    /// request inside its range whose frame index is above `floor` raises
272	    /// it, and every entry of a frame BELOW it goes as unused — the floor
273	    /// frame's own entry is the one `take` is about to ask for. A seek's
274	    /// session (a loop's return included) follows nothing until a request
275	    /// lands in its first `armFrames` frames: until then a request may be
276	    /// the old position's, served before AVFoundation cancelled it. Any
277	    /// thread; a no-op unless `key`'s session follows.
278	    func reach(_ key: Int, ticks: Ticks) {
279	        condition.lock()
280	        defer { condition.unlock() }
281	        guard let session = sessions[key], session.follows,
282	            ticks >= session.startTicks, ticks < session.endTicks
283	        else { return }
284	        let index = Int(clamping: (ticks - session.startTicks) / session.frameTicks)
285	        if !session.armed {
286	            guard index < Self.armFrames else { return }
287	            session.armed = true
288	        }
289	        guard index > session.floor else { return }
290	        session.floor = index
291	        if aheadOrigin?.key == key { kept.clearAhead(below: index) }
292	        let passed = session.slots.filter { $0.value.index < index }
293	        for (slot, entry) in passed {
294	            session.slots[slot] = nil
295	            release(entry, from: session)
296	        }
297	        session.unused += passed.count
298	        condition.broadcast()
299	    }
300	
301	    /// The worker's raster for `slot` when its texture key is `textureKey`,
302	    /// else nil. A keeping key's kept raster for `textureKey` answers first,
303	    /// session or none, and takes the slot out. Every entry of an earlier
304	    /// frame goes as unused. Waits for the entry's worker, or for `stop` — a
305	    /// wait `stop` ends counts as nothing. In a following session an entry
306	    /// the worker left to the pool counts `missed`: playback may have
307	    /// dropped the frame that filled it.
308	    func take(_ key: Int, slot: Slot, textureKey: String) -> Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>? {
309	        condition.lock()
310	        defer { condition.unlock() }
311	        if keeping.contains(key), let raster = kept.raster(key, textureKey) {
312	            if let session = sessions[key] {
313	                if let entry = session.slots[slot] {
314	                    remove(slot, entry, from: session)
315	                    condition.broadcast()
316	                }
317	                session.kept += 1
318	            }
319	            keptHits += 1
320	            return .success(raster)
321	        }
322	        guard let session = sessions[key] else { return nil }
323	        guard let entry = session.slots[slot] else {
324	            session.missed += 1
325	            return nil
326	        }
327	        remove(slot, entry, from: session)
328	        condition.broadcast()
329	        while !entry.done, !session.stopped { condition.wait() }
330	        guard entry.done else { return nil }
331	        if session.follows, entry.deferred, textureKey == entry.textureKey {
332	            session.missed += 1
333	            return nil
334	        }
335	        if entry.done, let raster = entry.raster, entry.textureKey == textureKey {
336	            session.hits += 1
337	            return raster
338	        }
339	        session.mismatched += 1
340	        return nil
341	    }
342	
343	    /// `take`'s removal for a slot the pool answered: never waits. A keeping
344	    /// key's kept frame for `textureKey` is touched first, session or none.
345	    func discard(_ key: Int, slot: Slot, textureKey: String) {
346	        condition.lock()
347	        defer { condition.unlock() }
348	        if keeping.contains(key) { _ = kept.raster(key, textureKey) }
349	        guard let session = sessions[key], let entry = session.slots[slot] else { return }
350	        remove(slot, entry, from: session)
351	        session.unused += 1
352	        condition.broadcast()
353	    }
354	
355	    /// `slot` and every entry of an earlier frame out of `session`, the
356	    /// earlier ones counted unused. Under `condition`.
357	    private func remove(_ slot: Slot, _ entry: Entry, from session: Session) {
358	        let earlier = session.slots.filter { $0.value.index < entry.index }
359	        for (old, value) in earlier {
360	            session.slots[old] = nil
361	            release(value, from: session)
362	        }
363	        session.unused += earlier.count
364	        session.slots[slot] = nil
365	        release(entry, from: session)
366	    }
367	
368	    /// An entry's bytes out of the totals, once; a keeping key's finished
369	    /// raster then kept, room permitting (true when it is). Under `condition`.
370	    @discardableResult
371	    private func release(_ entry: Entry, from session: Session) -> Bool {
372	        guard entry.bytes > 0 else { return false }
373	        session.heldBytes -= entry.bytes
374	        heldTotal -= entry.bytes
375	        heldEntries -= 1
376	        entry.bytes = 0
377	        guard keeping.contains(session.key), entry.done,
378	            case .success(let raster)? = entry.raster, let textureKey = entry.textureKey,
379	            raster.bgra.count <= budgetBytes - heldTotal
380	        else { return false }
381	        kept.insert(session.key, textureKey, raster)
382	        kept.trim(toFit: budgetBytes - heldTotal)
383	        return kept.contains(session.key, textureKey)
384	    }
385	
386	    // MARK: - Workers
387	
388	    /// One graphic layer a worker will draw.
389	    private struct Job {
390	        let slot: Slot
391	        let entry: Entry
392	        let module: GraphicModule
393	    }
394	
395	    private func work(_ session: Session) {
396	        while let index = claim(session) {
397	            let time = CMTimeAdd(
398	                session.start,
399	                CMTimeMultiply(session.frameDuration, multiplier: Int32(clamping: index)))
400	            let t = CompositionBuilder.ticks(time)
401	            if t >= session.endTicks {
402	                condition.lock()
403	                session.exhausted = true
404	                condition.broadcast()
405	                condition.unlock()
406	                break
407	            }
408	            guard let recipe = RecipeSource.shared.recipe(for: session.key, at: t),
409	                let resolved = GraphicRegistry.shared.resolve(session.key)
410	            else { continue }
411	            var wanted: [(slot: Slot, module: GraphicModule)] = []
412	            for layer in recipe.layers where layer.opacity > 0 {
413	                guard case .graphic(let name, _, let frame, let props, let ctx) = layer.source,
414	                    case .compiled(let module, _, _, _)? = resolved.set.modules[name]
415	                else { continue }
416	                let size = layer.sourceSizeCG ?? CGSize(width: 640, height: 360)
417	                let slot = Slot(
418	                    name: name, frame: frame, width: Int(size.width), height: Int(size.height),
419	                    propsJSON: props, ctxJSON: ctx)
420	                wanted.append((slot, module))
421	            }
422	            guard !wanted.isEmpty else { continue }
423	            guard let jobs = insert(wanted, index: index, into: session) else { break }
424	            draw(jobs, session: session, resolved: resolved)
425	        }
426	        condition.lock()
427	        session.liveWorkers -= 1
428	        let ends = session.liveWorkers == 0 && (session.stopped || session.background)
429	        if ends, sessions[session.key] === session { sessions[session.key] = nil }
430	        if ends, session.background, !session.stopped { endPassActivity() }
431	        let line = ends ? logLine(session) : nil
432	        condition.broadcast()
433	        condition.unlock()
434	        if let line = line { NSLog("%@", line) }
435	    }
436	
437	    /// The next frame index, once the held rasters of every session are
438	    /// under the budget and this session under `entryCeiling` entries; nil
439	    /// once stopped or exhausted. A following session's never at or before
440	    /// `floor`, and from the last pass's key it also waits while the held
441	    /// and marked bytes reach the budget; a pass ends `full` there (G-38).
442	    private func claim(_ session: Session) -> Int? {
443	        condition.lock()
444	        defer { condition.unlock() }
445	        while !session.stopped, !session.exhausted {
446	            if session.background, kept.aheadBytes + heldTotal >= budgetBytes {
447	                (session.exhausted, session.end) = (true, "full")
448	                condition.broadcast()
449	                break
450	            }
451	            let waits =
452	                heldTotal >= budgetBytes || session.slots.count >= Self.entryCeiling
453	                || session.follows && aheadOrigin?.key == session.key
454	                    && heldTotal + kept.aheadBytes >= budgetBytes
455	            guard waits else { break }
456	            condition.wait()
457	        }
458	        guard !session.stopped, !session.exhausted else { return nil }
459	        if session.follows, session.next <= session.floor {
460	            session.skipped += session.floor + 1 - session.next
461	            session.next = session.floor + 1
462	        }
463	        let index = session.next
464	        session.next += 1
465	        return index
466	    }
467	
468	    /// Every absent slot of frame `index` inserted under ONE hold, the totals
469	    /// and peaks raised and the kept frames trimmed to the room left; nil
470	    /// once stopped. A play from the last pass's key first waits for room
471	    /// beside the marked frames; a pass without room ends `full` (G-38).
472	    private func insert(
473	        _ wanted: [(slot: Slot, module: GraphicModule)], index: Int, into session: Session
474	    ) -> [Job]? {
475	        condition.lock()
476	        defer { condition.unlock() }
477	        let slots = wanted.map(\.slot)
478	        while session.follows, aheadOrigin?.key == session.key, !session.stopped,
479	            !roomAhead(for: slots) { condition.wait() }
480	        guard !session.stopped else { return nil }
481	        if session.background, !roomAhead(for: slots) {
482	            (session.exhausted, session.end) = (true, "full")
483	            return nil
484	        }
485	        session.framesWithGraphics += 1
486	        var jobs: [Job] = []
487	        for (slot, module) in wanted where session.slots[slot] == nil {
488	            let entry = Entry(index: index, bytes: slot.width * slot.height * 4)
489	            session.slots[slot] = entry
490	            session.heldBytes += entry.bytes
491	            heldTotal += entry.bytes
492	            if entry.bytes > 0 { heldEntries += 1 }
493	            jobs.append(Job(slot: slot, entry: entry, module: module))
494	        }
495	        heldPeakBytes = max(heldPeakBytes, heldTotal)
496	        heldPeakEntries = max(heldPeakEntries, heldEntries)
497	        kept.trim(toFit: budgetBytes - heldTotal)
498	        if !jobs.isEmpty { condition.broadcast() }
499	        return jobs
500	    }
501	
502	    /// Each job's SVG, key and raster, outside the lock; `stopped` checked
503	    /// between jobs, and the rest marked done. A texture key an earlier
504	    /// frame's entry rasterizes, or the key keeps, is left to the compositor.
505	    private func draw(
506	        _ jobs: [Job], session: Session, resolved: (set: GraphicSet, budgetMs: Int)
507	    ) {
508	        for (position, job) in jobs.enumerated() {
509	            condition.lock()
510	            let stopped = session.stopped
511	            if stopped {
512	                for rest in jobs[position...] { rest.entry.done = true }
513	                condition.broadcast()
514	            }
515	            condition.unlock()
516	            if stopped { return }
517	            let slot = job.slot
518	            guard let drawn = try? job.module.svg(
519	                frame: slot.frame, propsJSON: slot.propsJSON, ctxJSON: slot.ctxJSON,
520	                budgetMs: resolved.budgetMs)
521	            else {
522	                finish(job, in: session, raster: nil)
523	                continue
524	            }
525	            let key = LayerRenderers.textureKey(
526	                svg: drawn.svg, width: slot.width, height: slot.height,
527	                libraryVersion: resolved.set.libraryVersion)
528	            condition.lock()
529	            job.entry.textureKey = key
530	            let keptAlready = keeping.contains(session.key) && kept.contains(session.key, key)
531	            if keptAlready || session.recentIndex(key).map({ $0 < job.entry.index }) == true {
532	                session.touch(key)
533	                job.entry.done = true
534	                job.entry.deferred = true
535	                release(job.entry, from: session)
536	                if session.background, !session.stopped {
537	                    if session.slots[job.slot] === job.entry { session.slots[job.slot] = nil }
538	                    if keptAlready, kept.raster(session.key, key) != nil {
539	                        kept.markAhead(session.key, key, index: job.entry.index)
540	                        session.alreadyKept += 1
541	                    } else if let first = session.slots.values.first(where: {
542	                        !$0.done && $0.textureKey == key && $0.index < job.entry.index
543	                    }) {
544	                        (first.sharers, first.sharedUpTo) =
545	                            (first.sharers + 1, max(first.sharedUpTo, job.entry.index))
546	                    }
547	                }
548	                condition.broadcast()
549	                condition.unlock()
550	                continue
551	            }
552	            session.touch(key, index: job.entry.index)
553	            condition.unlock()
554	            let raster = Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>(catching: {
555	                try resolved.set.library.rasterize(
556	                    drawn.svg, width: slot.width, height: slot.height)
557	            })
558	            finish(job, in: session, raster: raster)
559	        }
560	    }
561	
562	    /// `job`'s raster in; a pass's entry leaves its slot, its raster kept and marked.
563	    private func finish(
564	        _ job: Job, in session: Session, raster: Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>?) {
565	        condition.lock()
566	        job.entry.raster = raster
567	        job.entry.done = true
568	        if session.background, !session.stopped {
569	            if session.slots[job.slot] === job.entry { session.slots[job.slot] = nil }
570	            if release(job.entry, from: session), let textureKey = job.entry.textureKey {
571	                let entry = job.entry
572	                kept.markAhead(session.key, textureKey, index: max(entry.index, entry.sharedUpTo))
573	                (session.drawn, session.alreadyKept) =
574	                    (session.drawn + 1, session.alreadyKept + entry.sharers)
575	            }
576	        }
577	        condition.broadcast()
578	        condition.unlock()
579	    }
580	
581	    /// The session's one line, once. Under `condition`.
582	    private func logLine(_ session: Session) -> String? {
583	        guard !session.logged else { return nil }
584	        session.logged = true
585	        if session.background {
586	            return backgroundLine(
587	                key: session.key, workers: session.workerCount, start: session.startTicks,
588	                frames: session.framesWithGraphics, counts: (session.drawn, session.alreadyKept),
589	                end: session.end)
590	        }
591	        let line =
592	            "[framejob] graphic prefetch: key \(session.key), \(session.workerCount) workers, "
593	            + "\(session.framesWithGraphics) frames with graphics, \(session.hits) hits, "
594	            + "\(session.mismatched) mismatched, \(session.missed) missed, "
595	            + "\(session.unused) unused"
596	        guard session.follows else { return line }
597	        return line + ", playback from \(session.startTicks), \(session.skipped) skipped, "
598	            + "\(session.kept) kept"
599	    }
600	}

3	/// Settings ▸ Playback ▸ Background render (spec §11 G-38 (a)): a person's
4	/// setting, like AI-11's model and R6-12's key — no tool reads or writes it
5	/// and it has no MCP mirror. `PlaybackSettingsPane` is its one writer; a
6	/// proof sets it in the argument domain and writes nothing.
7	struct BackgroundRenderSettings: Equatable {
8	    /// Bool; absent = true.
9	    static let enabledKey = "FrameJobBackgroundRender"
10	    /// Int seconds; absent = the default, outside the range clamped into it.
11	    static let delayKey = "FrameJobBackgroundRenderDelay"
12	    static let defaultDelay = 5
13	    static let delayRange = 1...60
14	
15	    var enabled = true
16	    var delaySeconds = BackgroundRenderSettings.defaultDelay
17	
18	    static func load(from defaults: UserDefaults = .standard) -> BackgroundRenderSettings {
19	        var settings = BackgroundRenderSettings()
20	        if defaults.object(forKey: enabledKey) != nil {
21	            settings.enabled = defaults.bool(forKey: enabledKey)
22	        }
23	        if defaults.object(forKey: delayKey) != nil {
24	            let seconds = defaults.integer(forKey: delayKey)
25	            settings.delaySeconds = min(max(seconds, delayRange.lowerBound), delayRange.upperBound)
26	        }
27	        return settings
28	    }
29	
30	    /// Writes both keys.
31	    func save(to defaults: UserDefaults = .standard) {
32	        defaults.set(enabled, forKey: Self.enabledKey)
33	        defaults.set(delaySeconds, forKey: Self.delayKey)
34	    }
35	}
36	
37	/// What the idle clock's door answered (`Playback.startBackgroundRender`).
38	enum BackgroundStart {
39	    case started
40	    case notNeeded
41	    /// Seeking, restoring, rebuilding, holding, or the start refused (a
42	    /// window plays): the clock runs again.
43	    case busy
44	}
45	
46	/// The idle clock (spec §11 G-38 (b), (c)). Main only.
47	///
48	/// **Activity** restarts it and stops the running background pass at once:
49	/// every event in `activityEvents` the app receives (a local monitor, so
50	/// pointer motion alone and events in other apps do not count), every
51	/// `.projectDocumentDidChange` of any document (live ticks included), and
52	/// every `syncPrefetch` of any transport — play, pause, a rate change, a
53	/// seek — which also makes that transport `current`. An agent's call counts
54	/// only when it edits or moves a transport.
55	///
56	/// **At the delay** (read from the stored setting at every restart), with
57	/// the setting on and no transport playing, `current` is asked to start a
58	/// pass; a playing transport or `.busy` runs the clock again, `.notNeeded`
59	/// waits for the next activity. `current` is weak,
60	/// and an invalidated `Playback` has no item, so a late fire finds nothing.
61	final class BackgroundRender {
62	    static let shared = BackgroundRender()
63	    static let activityEvents: NSEvent.EventTypeMask = [
64	        .keyDown, .flagsChanged, .leftMouseDown, .leftMouseDragged, .rightMouseDown,
65	        .rightMouseDragged, .otherMouseDown, .otherMouseDragged, .scrollWheel, .magnify, .rotate,
66	        .swipe, .smartMagnify,
67	    ]
68	
69	    private weak var current: Playback?
70	    /// Every transport that has moved: none may play when a pass starts.
71	    private let transports = NSHashTable<Playback>.weakObjects()
72	    private var timer: Timer?
73	    private var monitor: Any?
74	    private var observer: NSObjectProtocol?
75	
76	    private init() {
77	        monitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: Self.activityEvents) {
78	            [weak self] event in
79	            self?.noteActivity(from: nil)
80	            return event
81	        }
82	        observer = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
83	            forName: .projectDocumentDidChange, object: nil, queue: nil
84	        ) { [weak self] _ in
85	            self?.noteActivity(from: nil)
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    /// Activity: `playback`, when given, becomes `current`; the running pass
90	    /// stops; the one timer restarts at the stored delay.
91	    func noteActivity(from playback: Playback?) {
92	        if let playback {
93	            current = playback
94	            transports.add(playback)
95	        }
96	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.stopBackground()
97	        restartClock()
98	    }
99	
100	    private func restartClock() {
101	        timer?.invalidate()
102	        let delay = TimeInterval(BackgroundRenderSettings.load().delaySeconds)
103	        timer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: delay, repeats: false) { [weak self] _ in
104	            self?.idle()
105	        }
106	    }
107	
108	    /// A window that plays — forward or in reverse, with graphics or
109	    /// without — runs the clock again (G-38 (c)).
110	    private func idle() {
111	        timer = nil
112	        guard BackgroundRenderSettings.load().enabled else { return }
113	        let playing = transports.allObjects.contains { $0.rate != 0 }
114	        if playing || current?.startBackgroundRender() == .busy { restartClock() }
115	    }
116	}

3	
4	/// A playing preview's graphics prefetch (issue #127, spec §11 G-36): the
5	/// workers `GraphicPrefetch` runs for an export, run on this document's own
6	/// key while the transport plays forward over a project that draws a graphic.
7	/// The compositor stays the one consumer and the texture key decides, so
8	/// every frame is the serial path's (G-26 (c)).
9	///
10	/// Every `syncPrefetch` is also activity for the idle clock, and
11	/// `startBackgroundRender()` is the clock's door to a paused pass (G-38,
12	/// `BackgroundRender.swift`).
13	///
14	/// `Playback.swift` calls `syncPrefetch(from:)` at the three moments the
15	/// session's start can move — the rate KVO, `startSeek` (with the seek's
16	/// TARGET, never `currentTime`, which still reads the player there) and a
17	/// property-only edit while playing — and stops the session in `invalidate`
18	/// and `deinit`. An item swap needs no call of its own: `finishRebuild`'s
19	/// `startSeek` and its rate restore cover it. This file only reads the
20	/// transport's state; the seek and restore rules stay `Playback.swift`'s.
21	extension Playback {
22	    /// Stops this document's playback session, then starts a fresh one at
23	    /// `start` when the live rate is above 0, an item is built and the
24	    /// project draws a graphic; `seeking` when a seek to `start` begins it
25	    /// (its session follows from the seek's own frame, G-36 (d)). Main only.
26	    ///
27	    /// The grid (G-36 (b)): `start` snapped down onto the composition's frame
28	    /// grid from 0, at the built composition's `frameDuration`, to the in/out
29	    /// range's end while playback loops inside it, else to the composition's
30	    /// end.
31	    func syncPrefetch(from start: Ticks, seeking: Bool = false) {
32	        BackgroundRender.shared.noteActivity(from: self)
33	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.stop(recipeKey)
34	        guard rate > 0, let built, drawsGraphics else { return }
35	        guard let grid = prefetchGrid(from: start, built: built) else { return }
36	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.start(
37	            key: recipeKey, range: grid.range, frameDuration: grid.frameDuration, follows: true,
38	            seeking: seeking)
39	    }
40	
41	    /// The idle clock's pass (G-38 (c)): busy while a seek, a restore, a
42	    /// rebuild or a hold is in flight, or when `GraphicPrefetch` refuses (a
43	    /// pass or a play runs); not needed unless paused over a built item that
44	    /// draws a graphic, with the document's graphics still registered (an
45	    /// open document), a grid from the playhead, the prefetch switch off and
46	    /// a key that keeps (G-38 (e): so neither switch re-arms the clock).
47	    /// Main only.
48	    func startBackgroundRender() -> BackgroundStart {
49	        if isSeeking || restoring || rebuilding || holding { return .busy }
50	        guard rate == 0, drawsGraphics, let built = built,
51	            GraphicRegistry.shared.resolve(recipeKey) != nil,
52	            !UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: GraphicPrefetch.offDefaultsKey),
53	            GraphicPrefetch.shared.keeps(recipeKey),
54	            let grid = prefetchGrid(from: currentTime, built: built)
55	        else { return .notNeeded }
56	        let started = GraphicPrefetch.shared.start(
57	            key: recipeKey, range: grid.range, frameDuration: grid.frameDuration,
58	            background: true)
59	        return started ? .started : .busy
60	    }
61	
62	    /// G-36 (b)'s grid from `start`: snapped down onto the composition's
63	    /// frame grid from 0, at the built composition's `frameDuration`, to the
64	    /// in/out range's end while playback loops inside it, else to the
65	    /// composition's end. Nil when empty.
66	    private func prefetchGrid(
67	        from start: Ticks, built: BuiltComposition
68	    ) -> (range: CMTimeRange, frameDuration: CMTime)? {
69	        let frameDuration = built.videoConfiguration.frameDuration
70	        let frame = CompositionBuilder.ticks(frameDuration)
71	        guard frame > 0 else { return nil }
72	        let first = max(0, start) / frame * frame
73	        var end = CompositionBuilder.ticks(built.composition.duration)
74	        if let loop = loopRange, loop.duration > 0, start < loop.start + loop.duration {
75	            end = min(end, loop.start + loop.duration)
76	        }
77	        guard end > first else { return nil }

1	// app/Sources/GraphicPrefetch.swift — an export's graphics, and a playing
2	// preview's, rasterized AHEAD of the compositor, on worker threads (spec §11
3	// G-26, G-36 and G-37, issue #127).
4	//
5	// **The compositor stays the one writer.** A worker runs a frame's graphic
6	// modules and rasterizes their SVG into a slot; the compositor still runs
7	// `svg` itself, records every warning and failure and draws every error card
8	// (G-8), and takes a slot's raster only on a pool miss and only when the
9	// worker's texture key equals its own (`LayerRenderersGraphic.swift`). So a
10	// worker can be wrong, late or absent and the file is still the serial
11	// path's, byte for byte.
12	//
13	// **Where it runs.** An `ExportWriter` export with a pinned set and a
14	// graphic in range (`Exporter.startGraphicPrefetch`), and a preview playing
15	// forward over a project that draws a graphic, on the document's own key
16	// (`Playback+Prefetch.swift`, G-36); never GIF/APNG, a one-frame render or a
17	// paused or reversing preview. `FrameJobGraphicPrefetchOff` (YES) is the
18	// measurement switch back to the serial path for both.
19	//
20	// **The grid.** A worker walks `range.start + i × frameDuration` on the
21	// export's own key: the core snaps the start onto the export's own grid
22	// from 0, at the export's rate after any override, so those are the
23	// instants the writer asks the compositor for. A playback session's grid
24	// starts at the seek target or the playhead, snapped down onto the
25	// composition's own grid from 0. A worker reads only through
26	// `RecipeSource.recipe(for:at:)` and `GraphicRegistry.resolve` — the
27	// export's PINNED set (G-13), or the document's — and never records a report.
28	//
29	// **Following.** A playback session `follows`: the compositor reports every
30	// request's time (`reach`), a worker never claims a frame at or before the
31	// last one reached (the frames passed over are `skipped`), and a held entry
32	// of an earlier frame goes as unused. A request outside the session's range
33	// is not followed, and a seek's session follows nothing until a request
34	// lands in its first `armFrames` frames: a seek installs the session before
35	// AVFoundation cancels the old position's requests, and those still served
36	// in between must not move the new session's floor. An export session never reads `floor`,
37	// `skipped` or `deferred`, and its log line is unchanged; a following one's
38	// appends `, playback from <start>, <skipped> skipped, <kept> kept`.
39	//
40	// **Bounds (G-37).** Bytes decide how far ahead workers go: a worker waits
41	// while the held rasters of ALL sessions reach the one process-wide budget
42	// (a quarter of physical memory, less under memory pressure), or while its
43	// session holds `entryCeiling` entries, bytes or none. A playing document's
44	// key KEEPS the frames it drew (`GraphicPrefetch+Memory.swift`): a finished
45	// raster leaving its slot goes into the kept frames, `take` answers from them
46	// before any slot, and a worker skips a texture key already kept. The kept
47	// frames fill only the room the held rasters leave.
48	//
49	// **One `NSCondition`** guards `sessions`, the kept frames, every total and
50	// every session and entry field, broadcast on every change (`CacheLedger`'s
51	// precedent). A worker never
52	// waits while it holds an unfinished entry, so the compositor's `take`, the
53	// one wait on its queue, always ends: on `done` or on `stop`. Each worker is
54	// a Foundation `Thread` with a stack above the engine's own 1 MiB; its
55	// QuickJS engines die with it.

526	                svg: drawn.svg, width: slot.width, height: slot.height,
527	                libraryVersion: resolved.set.libraryVersion)
528	            condition.lock()
529	            job.entry.textureKey = key
530	            let keptAlready = keeping.contains(session.key) && kept.contains(session.key, key)
531	            if keptAlready || session.recentIndex(key).map({ $0 < job.entry.index }) == true {
532	                session.touch(key)
533	                job.entry.done = true
534	                job.entry.deferred = true
535	                release(job.entry, from: session)
536	                if session.background, !session.stopped {
537	                    if session.slots[job.slot] === job.entry { session.slots[job.slot] = nil }
538	                    if keptAlready, kept.raster(session.key, key) != nil {
539	                        kept.markAhead(session.key, key, index: job.entry.index)
540	                        session.alreadyKept += 1

542	                        !$0.done && $0.textureKey == key && $0.index < job.entry.index
543	                    }) {
544	                        (first.sharers, first.sharedUpTo) =
545	                            (first.sharers + 1, max(first.sharedUpTo, job.entry.index))
546	                    }
547	                }
548	                condition.broadcast()
549	                condition.unlock()
550	                continue
551	            }
552	            session.touch(key, index: job.entry.index)
553	            condition.unlock()
554	            let raster = Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>(catching: {
555	                try resolved.set.library.rasterize(
556	                    drawn.svg, width: slot.width, height: slot.height)
557	            })
558	            finish(job, in: session, raster: raster)
559	        }

562	    /// `job`'s raster in; a pass's entry leaves its slot, its raster kept and marked.
563	    private func finish(
564	        _ job: Job, in session: Session, raster: Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>?) {
565	        condition.lock()
566	        job.entry.raster = raster
567	        job.entry.done = true
568	        if session.background, !session.stopped {
569	            if session.slots[job.slot] === job.entry { session.slots[job.slot] = nil }
570	            if release(job.entry, from: session), let textureKey = job.entry.textureKey {
571	                let entry = job.entry
572	                kept.markAhead(session.key, textureKey, index: max(entry.index, entry.sharedUpTo))
573	                (session.drawn, session.alreadyKept) =
574	                    (session.drawn + 1, session.alreadyKept + entry.sharers)
575	            }
576	        }
577	        condition.broadcast()
578	        condition.unlock()
579	    }
580	
581	    /// The session's one line, once. Under `condition`.
582	    private func logLine(_ session: Session) -> String? {
583	        guard !session.logged else { return nil }
584	        session.logged = true
585	        if session.background {
586	            return backgroundLine(
587	                key: session.key, workers: session.workerCount, start: session.startTicks,
588	                frames: session.framesWithGraphics, counts: (session.drawn, session.alreadyKept),
589	                end: session.end)
590	        }
591	        let line =
592	            "[framejob] graphic prefetch: key \(session.key), \(session.workerCount) workers, "
593	            + "\(session.framesWithGraphics) frames with graphics, \(session.hits) hits, "
594	            + "\(session.mismatched) mismatched, \(session.missed) missed, "
595	            + "\(session.unused) unused"
596	        guard session.follows else { return line }
597	        return line + ", playback from \(session.startTicks), \(session.skipped) skipped, "
598	            + "\(session.kept) kept"
599	    }

3	/// Settings ▸ Playback ▸ Background render (spec §11 G-38 (a)): a person's
4	/// setting, like AI-11's model and R6-12's key — no tool reads or writes it
5	/// and it has no MCP mirror. `PlaybackSettingsPane` is its one writer; a
6	/// proof sets it in the argument domain and writes nothing.
7	struct BackgroundRenderSettings: Equatable {
8	    /// Bool; absent = true.
9	    static let enabledKey = "FrameJobBackgroundRender"
10	    /// Int seconds; absent = the default, outside the range clamped into it.
11	    static let delayKey = "FrameJobBackgroundRenderDelay"
12	    static let defaultDelay = 5
13	    static let delayRange = 1...60
14	
15	    var enabled = true
16	    var delaySeconds = BackgroundRenderSettings.defaultDelay
17	
18	    static func load(from defaults: UserDefaults = .standard) -> BackgroundRenderSettings {
19	        var settings = BackgroundRenderSettings()
20	        if defaults.object(forKey: enabledKey) != nil {
21	            settings.enabled = defaults.bool(forKey: enabledKey)
22	        }
23	        if defaults.object(forKey: delayKey) != nil {
24	            let seconds = defaults.integer(forKey: delayKey)
25	            settings.delaySeconds = min(max(seconds, delayRange.lowerBound), delayRange.upperBound)
26	        }
27	        return settings
28	    }
29	
30	    /// Writes both keys.
31	    func save(to defaults: UserDefaults = .standard) {
32	        defaults.set(enabled, forKey: Self.enabledKey)
33	        defaults.set(delaySeconds, forKey: Self.delayKey)
34	    }
35	}
36	
37	/// What the idle clock's door answered (`Playback.startBackgroundRender`).
38	enum BackgroundStart {
39	    case started
40	    case notNeeded
41	    /// Seeking, restoring, rebuilding, holding, or the start refused (a
42	    /// window plays): the clock runs again.
43	    case busy
44	}
45	
46	/// The idle clock (spec §11 G-38 (b), (c)). Main only.
47	///
48	/// **Activity** restarts it and stops the running background pass at once:
49	/// every event in `activityEvents` the app receives (a local monitor, so
50	/// pointer motion alone and events in other apps do not count), every
51	/// `.projectDocumentDidChange` of any document (live ticks included), and
52	/// every `syncPrefetch` of any transport — play, pause, a rate change, a
53	/// seek — which also makes that transport `current`. An agent's call counts
54	/// only when it edits or moves a transport.
55	///
56	/// **At the delay** (read from the stored setting at every restart), with
57	/// the setting on and no transport playing, `current` is asked to start a
58	/// pass; a playing transport or `.busy` runs the clock again, `.notNeeded`
59	/// waits for the next activity. `current` is weak,
60	/// and an invalidated `Playback` has no item, so a late fire finds nothing.
61	final class BackgroundRender {
62	    static let shared = BackgroundRender()
63	    static let activityEvents: NSEvent.EventTypeMask = [
64	        .keyDown, .flagsChanged, .leftMouseDown, .leftMouseDragged, .rightMouseDown,
65	        .rightMouseDragged, .otherMouseDown, .otherMouseDragged, .scrollWheel, .magnify, .rotate,
66	        .swipe, .smartMagnify,
67	    ]
68	
69	    private weak var current: Playback?
70	    /// Every transport that has moved: none may play when a pass starts.
71	    private let transports = NSHashTable<Playback>.weakObjects()
72	    private var timer: Timer?
73	    private var monitor: Any?
74	    private var observer: NSObjectProtocol?
75	
76	    private init() {
77	        monitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: Self.activityEvents) {
78	            [weak self] event in
79	            self?.noteActivity(from: nil)
80	            return event
81	        }
82	        observer = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
83	            forName: .projectDocumentDidChange, object: nil, queue: nil
84	        ) { [weak self] _ in
85	            self?.noteActivity(from: nil)
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    /// Activity: `playback`, when given, becomes `current`; the running pass
90	    /// stops; the one timer restarts at the stored delay.
91	    func noteActivity(from playback: Playback?) {
92	        if let playback {
93	            current = playback
94	            transports.add(playback)
95	        }
96	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.stopBackground()
97	        restartClock()
98	    }
99	
100	    private func restartClock() {
101	        timer?.invalidate()
102	        let delay = TimeInterval(BackgroundRenderSettings.load().delaySeconds)
103	        timer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: delay, repeats: false) { [weak self] _ in
104	            self?.idle()
105	        }
106	    }
107	
108	    /// A window that plays — forward or in reverse, with graphics or
109	    /// without — runs the clock again (G-38 (c)).
110	    private func idle() {
111	        timer = nil
112	        guard BackgroundRenderSettings.load().enabled else { return }
113	        let playing = transports.allObjects.contains { $0.rate != 0 }
114	        if playing || current?.startBackgroundRender() == .busy { restartClock() }
115	    }
116	}

2	import Foundation
3	
4	/// A playing preview's graphics prefetch (issue #127, spec §11 G-36): the
5	/// workers `GraphicPrefetch` runs for an export, run on this document's own
6	/// key while the transport plays forward over a project that draws a graphic.
7	/// The compositor stays the one consumer and the texture key decides, so
8	/// every frame is the serial path's (G-26 (c)).
9	///
10	/// Every `syncPrefetch` is also activity for the idle clock, and
11	/// `startBackgroundRender()` is the clock's door to a paused pass (G-38,
12	/// `BackgroundRender.swift`).
13	///
14	/// `Playback.swift` calls `syncPrefetch(from:)` at the three moments the
15	/// session's start can move — the rate KVO, `startSeek` (with the seek's
16	/// TARGET, never `currentTime`, which still reads the player there) and a
17	/// property-only edit while playing — and stops the session in `invalidate`
18	/// and `deinit`. An item swap needs no call of its own: `finishRebuild`'s
19	/// `startSeek` and its rate restore cover it. This file only reads the
20	/// transport's state; the seek and restore rules stay `Playback.swift`'s.
21	extension Playback {
22	    /// Stops this document's playback session, then starts a fresh one at
23	    /// `start` when the live rate is above 0, an item is built and the
24	    /// project draws a graphic; `seeking` when a seek to `start` begins it
25	    /// (its session follows from the seek's own frame, G-36 (d)). Main only.
26	    ///
27	    /// The grid (G-36 (b)): `start` snapped down onto the composition's frame
28	    /// grid from 0, at the built composition's `frameDuration`, to the in/out
29	    /// range's end while playback loops inside it, else to the composition's
30	    /// end.
31	    func syncPrefetch(from start: Ticks, seeking: Bool = false) {
32	        BackgroundRender.shared.noteActivity(from: self)
33	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.stop(recipeKey)
34	        guard rate > 0, let built, drawsGraphics else { return }
35	        guard let grid = prefetchGrid(from: start, built: built) else { return }
36	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.start(
37	            key: recipeKey, range: grid.range, frameDuration: grid.frameDuration, follows: true,
38	            seeking: seeking)
39	    }
40	
41	    /// The idle clock's pass (G-38 (c)): busy while a seek, a restore, a
42	    /// rebuild or a hold is in flight, or when `GraphicPrefetch` refuses (a
43	    /// pass or a play runs); not needed unless paused over a built item that
44	    /// draws a graphic, with the document's graphics still registered (an
45	    /// open document), a grid from the playhead, the prefetch switch off and
46	    /// a key that keeps (G-38 (e): so neither switch re-arms the clock).
47	    /// Main only.
48	    func startBackgroundRender() -> BackgroundStart {
49	        if isSeeking || restoring || rebuilding || holding { return .busy }
50	        guard rate == 0, drawsGraphics, let built = built,
51	            GraphicRegistry.shared.resolve(recipeKey) != nil,
52	            !UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: GraphicPrefetch.offDefaultsKey),
53	            GraphicPrefetch.shared.keeps(recipeKey),
54	            let grid = prefetchGrid(from: currentTime, built: built)
55	        else { return .notNeeded }
56	        let started = GraphicPrefetch.shared.start(
57	            key: recipeKey, range: grid.range, frameDuration: grid.frameDuration,
58	            background: true)
59	        return started ? .started : .busy
60	    }
61	
62	    /// G-36 (b)'s grid from `start`: snapped down onto the composition's
63	    /// frame grid from 0, at the built composition's `frameDuration`, to the
64	    /// in/out range's end while playback loops inside it, else to the
65	    /// composition's end. Nil when empty.
66	    private func prefetchGrid(
67	        from start: Ticks, built: BuiltComposition
68	    ) -> (range: CMTimeRange, frameDuration: CMTime)? {
69	        let frameDuration = built.videoConfiguration.frameDuration
70	        let frame = CompositionBuilder.ticks(frameDuration)
71	        guard frame > 0 else { return nil }
72	        let first = max(0, start) / frame * frame
73	        var end = CompositionBuilder.ticks(built.composition.duration)
74	        if let loop = loopRange, loop.duration > 0, start < loop.start + loop.duration {
75	            end = min(end, loop.start + loop.duration)
76	        }
77	        guard end > first else { return nil }
78	        let range = CMTimeRange(
79	            start: CompositionBuilder.time(first), end: CompositionBuilder.time(end))
80	        return (range, frameDuration)
81	    }
82	
83	    /// Whether `snapshot` draws a graphic clip: on the timeline, or in any
84	    /// nest.
85	    static func drawsGraphics(_ snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) -> Bool {
86	        snapshot.clips.contains { $0.graphic != nil }
87	            || snapshot.nests.contains { nest in nest.clips.contains { $0.graphic != nil } }
88	    }
89	}

--- write_graphic
Writes the JavaScript module graphics/<name>.js in the project's package — atomically, creating graphics/ if it is absent — compiles it, and answers the compile of THAT text: ok, the module's meta and schema, and diagnostics [{level, message, line, column, frame}]. A module that does not compile is an answer, not an error: ok is false and the diagnostics say where; fix the source and write it again. With ok true, diagnostics are the module's top-level warnings (e.g. asset() outside render). clips lists the clips drawn by it, which redraw with the new text at once. A file write is not undoable and does not mark the project edited, but the text it replaced is kept — the last 10 per module; kept lists their revisions, newest first — and restore_graphic brings one back. Read graphic_reference first for the API.
--- render_graphic
Renders a module in graphics/ WITHOUT a clip — to look at it before placing it. png (the default) answers a contact sheet: the frames on a grid, each frame number printed under its cell, the cells scaled down (never the gaps or labels) so the sheet fits max_width; plus one sentence per frame that failed (drawn as its error card) or warned, with the engine's location. svg answers one frame's SVG text, its diagnostics and the ctx it was drawn with. ctx is a clip's: the canvas fps, durationInFrames from meta (else 5 s), the size from width/height, else meta, else the canvas. svg takes no path, background or max_width, which are the png sheet's, and writes no file. A frame at or past durationInFrames is drawn, with progress 1, as a longer clip draws it. A png sheet draws at most 134217728 px of frames (frames × width × height); past that the call is refused before any frame is drawn. No inspector control mirrors it: a person looks at the preview well.
--- render_frame
Renders one frame of the finished timeline as a picture so you can SEE the result — the verification hook. It goes through the same composition and the same Metal compositor an export does, so this is what the file will contain at that moment, not a preview of it. The image comes back both as an image block and as a file on disk whose path the text names. Use it before and after every edit. It writes a PNG to a temporary file unless path or format says otherwise, so a call that names neither is exactly the call it always was. When a graphic in the frame warned or failed, a sentence before the last names the graphic, its frame and the diagnostic; a failed graphic draws its error card in the picture. A media with a cursor file not in its picture (add_media's cursor) has its recorded cursor and click ripples drawn in its clips; when the file cannot be read the clip draws without one and a sentence says "The cursor of media M is not drawn: <why>." A clip with set_video cutout waits up to 30 s for its masks (a picture with subject foreground, its foreground masks; any other, its person masks); past that it is drawn uncut and a sentence before the last names it. In an HLG project (set_canvas output) the frame is a 16-bit PNG or a 10-bit HEIC labelled BT.2100 HLG; a JPEG, and any frame asked with sdr_version, is the project's SDR version, labelled BT.709. Its scopes read the picture it draws: in an HLG project the HLG signal, each JSON adding signal "hlg" and, for the waveform, parade and histogram, scale (the HLG % ticks in cd/m², reference white at 75 %), the luma and vectorscope taking Rec. 2020's weights and targets; the SDR version's scopes are an SDR project's.
--- export_status
How an export this launch started is going — Window ▸ Export Queue's row for it, read now: it never waits, so call it again after a pause. Always export_id, status (queued, running, done, failed or cancelled), path and elapsed (seconds since export was called, or to the finish once it has finished). queued adds waiting, the queue row's sentence, while the job waits for memory behind other AV1 and VP9 exports; queued and running add estimated_seconds on av1, av1_webm, vp9_webm and vp9_alpha_webm, the export sheet's estimate of the whole write in whole seconds, only an estimate. running adds progress (0 to 1) and phase while the exporter names one (the loudness measurement). done adds what the file holds: ok, bytes, the settings that were used (preset, container, codec, width, height, fps [num, den], start, duration), burn_in_timecode, dynamic_range in an HLG project (the picture written), encoder_speed on av1 and av1_webm, audio_bits on audio_wav and audio_aiff, stems [{name, tracks, path}] when stems was asked (each file beside the mix), loudness for every format that carries sound, normalised or not — summary, integrated_lufs, true_peak_dbtp, sample_peak_dbfs, gain_db, ceiling_dbtp (the master limiter's), limited_db (how far it turned the hottest peak down), capped_by_gain (the +40 dB cap decided the gain) and target_lufs when one was asked, from the mix as written — and graphic_warnings [{name, frame, message}], each distinct warning a graphic gave while the file was drawn, absent when none, and cursor_warnings [{media, path, message}], each media whose cursor file could not be drawn (its clips drew without one), absent when none. failed and cancelled add reason, the queue row's sentence. Only ids export returned are known, until Frame Job quits.
--- export
Starts writing the timeline to a file and answers AT ONCE with {export_id, path, status} — ⌘E, the export sheet's six controls (format, size, frame rate, quality, loudness, range) in the sheet's own vocabulary, all but the frame rate — this exports at the document's rate, or on gif and apng at the format's own rate (12.5 and 25 fps). The export is a job in the Export Queue, run one at a time behind any other export already there; status is queued or running. An av1, av1_webm or vp9_webm job also waits while the app's other AV1 and VP9 exports would hold more than a quarter of this Mac's memory with it, and a later job may run first meanwhile (export_status's waiting says so). Follow it with export_status, which never waits — call it again after a pause until status is done, failed or cancelled — and stop it with cancel_export. The export_id lasts until Frame Job quits. Every refusal comes back from this call, before anything is queued: a bad argument, a missing folder, and a graphic clip whose module does not compile; a failure while writing comes back from export_status, failed with its reason (a graphic that fails during the export stops it with no file left, naming the graphic and the frame). The preset is the ENCODING only and the size a separate choice defaulting to the document's own, or on gif and apng to the format's cap; the core resolves both into concrete settings (container, codec, size, rate, range) and hands them to the same exporter the sheet uses, so an agent export and a menu export cannot disagree. An existing file at the path is replaced, and the container's extension is added when the path has none. docs/guide/captions.md:115:**The transcript cache.** Each media file's transcript is kept in the project package and reused by the next run. A file whose cached transcript matches the request (same file, model, language, Speakers and Vocabulary) is not uploaded again and costs nothing. The caption style does not count, so restyling never uploads. A transcript made for Remove Filler Words also serves Generate Captions, so that file is not uploaded or billed again. The cache is kept per media entry, so two media entries over the same file are uploaded and billed separately. When no API key is set and every file in the run already has a current transcript, the hint changes to "Current cached transcripts will be used without an API key or network request." and **Generate** works without a key. input.old_string:
A frame fails when your code throws, when it takes more than 2 s to draw, or when its picture can't be made.

To find a failure before a long export, play the graphic through in the preview and watch for the [error card](/graphics/edit-a-module/#the-error-card). A frame has only 250 ms there, so the preview is the stricter of the two. A frame that takes between 250 ms and 2 s shows the card in the preview and exports normally.
